if active_days_ago <= 3 and plan != \"Free\":\n        return \"power_user\"\n    if active_days_ago <= 7:\n        return \"active\"\n    if active_days_ago <= 30:\n        return \"declining\"\n    if active_days_ago <= 90:\n        return \"dormant\"\n    return \"churned\"\n\n\ndef build_behavioral_signals(users: list[dict]) -> dict[str, object]:\n    \"\"\"Aggregate behavioral signals for an u.get(\"registered_days_ago\", u.get(\"active_days_ago\", 999)) for u in users\n    ]\n\n    lifecycle_counter: Counter[str] = Counter(detect_lifecycle_stage(u) for u in users)\n\n    new_inactive_pct 100\n    )\n\n    signals: dict[str, object] = {\n        \"population\": total,\n        \"lifecycle_distribution\": {\n            stage: count for stage, count in lifecycle_counter.most_common()\n facts.append(f\"{declining_pct}% 用户活跃度正在下降\")\n    if active_pct >= 50:\n        facts.append(f\"{active_pct}% 用户保持活跃\")\n\n    signals[\"key_facts\"] = facts\n    return signals\n\n\ndef      lang_pct_parts.append(f\"{name}({pct}%)\")\n\n    seg_s_pct = round(seg_counter.get(\"S\", 0) / total * 100) if total else 0\n    audience_summary = (\n        f\"共 {total:,}    )\n\n    return AudienceProfile(\n        total=total,\n        by_segment=dict(seg_counter),\n        by_lang=dict(lang_counter),\n        by_plan=dict(plan_counter),\n _build_character_summary(\n    seg: str,\n    paid_ratio: float,\n    avg_active_day: int,\n    behavioral: dict[str, object],\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a factual character description (no strategy — that's for AI).\"\"\"\n    lifecycle_dist = behavioral.get(\"lifecycle_distribution\", {})\n    key_facts: list[str] = list(behavioral.get(\"key_facts\", []))  # type: ignore[arg-type]\n\n    base_chars: dict[str, str] = {\n        \"S\": \"高价值付费活跃用户\",\n        \"A\": \"活跃用户，付费与免费混合\",\n        \"B\": \"以免费用户为主，近期活跃度偏低\",\n        \"C\": \"流失风险用户，极低活跃度\",\n    }\n    char = base_chars.get(seg, \"普通用户群体\")\n\n    parts = [\n        char,\n        f\"付费率{round(paid_ratio * 100)}%\",\n        f\"平均{avg_active_day}天前活跃\",\n    ]\n\n    dominant_stage = max(lifecycle_dist, Returns both content and AI decision rationale.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        content, decisions = await ai_service.generate_content(\n            material=req.material,\n            segment=req.segment,\n            segment_profile=req.segment_profile,\n            lang=req.lang,\n            goal_hint=req.goal_hint,\n            cta_url=req.cta_url,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        logger.error(\"Content generation failed: %s\", exc)\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,\n            detail=f\"AI content generation failed: {exc}\",\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:\n        logger.exception(\"Unexpected error during content generation\")\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,\n            detail=f\"AI provider error: {exc}\",\n        )\n\n    return GenerateContentResponse(\n        segment=req.segment,\n        lang=req.lang,\n        content=content,\n        ai_decisions=decisions,\n    )\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# POST /ai/auto-generate  —  SSE streaming: all segments x all languages\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@router.post(\"/auto-generate\")\nasync def auto_generate(\n    req: AutoGenerateRequest,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n):\n    \"\"\"Stream-generate content for every segment x language combination.\n\n    The AI autonomously decides tone, strategy, and marketing intent for\n    each segment. Brand names and product\n    names are preserved. {
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\features\\campaigns\\aiApi.ts",
 "contents": "/**\n * Real backend AI API client — autonomous mode.\n * AI decides tone/strategy/intent; frontend only sends material + optional goal hint.\n */\nimport type { AIDecisions, AudienceProfile, ContentFields, SegmentProfile } from '../../types';\n\nconst BASE = '/api';\n\nfunction authHeaders(): Record<string, string> {\n  const token = localStorage.getItem('edm_token');\n  return {\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n    ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction toBackendSegmentProfile(sp: SegmentProfile) {\n  return {\n    count: sp.count,\n    paid_ratio: sp.paidRatio,\n    top_plans: sp.topPlans,\n    character_summary: sp.characterSummary,\n    suggested_strategy: sp.suggestedStrategy,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction toBackendAudienceProfile(ap: AudienceProfile) {\n  const segment_profiles: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof toBackendSegmentProfile>> = {};\n  for (const [seg, profile] of Object.entries(ap.segmentProfiles)) {\n    segment_profiles[seg] = toBackendSegmentProfile(profile);\n  }\n  return {\n    total: ap.total,\n    top_languages: ap.topLanguages,\n    segment_profiles,\n    audience_summary: ap.audienceSummary,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction parseAIDecisions(raw: Record<string, unknown>): AIDecisions {\n  return {\n    detectedIntent: (raw.detected_intent as string) ?? '',\n    chosenTone: (raw.chosen_tone as string) ?? '',\n    strategyReasoning: (raw.strategy_reasoning as string) ?? '',\n  };\n}\n\n// ── Single content generation (autonomous) ─────────────────────────────────\n\nexport async function apiGenerateContent(params: {\n  campaignId: string;\n  material: string;\n  segment: string;\n  lang: string;\n  segmentProfile?: SegmentProfile | null;\n  goalHint?: string;\n  ctaUrl?: string;\n}): Promise<{ content: ContentFields; aiDecisions: AIDecisions }> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/generate-content`, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n    body: JSON.stringify({\n      campaign_id: params.campaignId,\n      material: params.material,\n      segment: params.segment,\n      lang: params.lang,\n      segment_profile: params.segmentProfile\n        ? toBackendSegmentProfile(params.segmentProfile)\n        : null,\n      goal_hint: params.goalHint ?? '',\n      cta_url: params.ctaUrl ?? null,\n    }),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n    throw new Error(err.detail ?? `AI 生成失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  }\n  const data = await resp.json() as {\n    content: ContentFields;\n    ai_decisions?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  };\n  return {\n    content: data.content,\n    aiDecisions: parseAIDecisions(data.ai_decisions ?? {}),\n  };\n}\n\n// ── Translation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport async function apiTranslateContent(params: {\n  content: ContentFields;\n  sourceLang: string;\n  targetLang: string;\n  segment?: string;\n}): Promise<ContentFields> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/translate`, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n    body: JSON.stringify({\n      content: params.content,\n      source_lang: params.sourceLang,\n      target_lang: params.targetLang,\n      segment: params.segment ?? '',\n    }),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n    throw new Error(err.detail ?? `AI 翻译失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  }\n  const data = await resp.json() as { content: ContentFields };\n  return data.content;\n}\n\n// ── Auto-generate (SSE streaming, autonomous) ─────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface AutoGenerateCallbacks {\n  onStrategy: (segment: string, strategy: string) => void;\n  onAIDecision: (segment: string, decisions: AIDecisions) => void;\n  onContentReady: (segment: string, lang: string, content: ContentFields) => void;\n  onProgress: (segment: string, lang: string, status: 'pending' | 'loading' | 'done' | 'error') => void;\n  onDone: (total: number, completed: number) => void;\n  onError?: (err: Error) => void;\n  onSegmentError?: (segment: string, lang: string, message: string) => void;\n}\n\nexport async function apiAutoGenerate(\n  params: {\n    campaignId: string;\n    material: string;\n    goalHint: string;\n    ctaUrl: string;\n    baseLang: string;\n    audienceProfile: AudienceProfile;\n  },\n  callbacks: AutoGenerateCallbacks,\n  signal?: AbortSignal,\n): Promise<void> {\n  for (const seg of Object.keys(params.audienceProfile.segmentProfiles)) {\n    for (const lang of params.audienceProfile.topLanguages) {\n      callbacks.onProgress(seg, lang, 'pending');\n    }\n  }\n\n  const token = localStorage.getItem('edm_token');\n\n  try {\n    const response = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/auto-generate`, {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),\n      },\n      body: JSON.stringify({\n        campaign_id: params.campaignId,\n        material: params.material,\n        goal_hint: params.goalHint,\n        cta_url: params.ctaUrl,\n        base_lang: params.baseLang,\n        audience_profile: toBackendAudienceProfile(params.audienceProfile),\n      }),\n      signal,\n    });\n\n    if (!response.ok || !response.body) {\n      const err = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n      if (response.status === 401) {\n        throw new Error(\n          err.detail === 'Token 已过期' || err.detail === '无效的 Token'\n            ? `${err.detail}，请重新登录后再试`\n            : '登录已失效（401），请重新登录后再试',\n        );\n      }\n      if (response.status === 403) {\n        throw new Error(\n          typeof err.detail === 'string' && err.detail\n            ? err.detail\n            : '未登录或无权访问，请先登录后再试',\n        );\n      }\n      throw new Error(err.detail ?? `AI 自动生成失败 (${response.status})`);\n    }\n\n    const reader = response.body.getReader();\n    const decoder = new TextDecoder();\n    let buffer = '';\n\n    while (true) {\n      const { done, value } = await reader.read();\n      if (done) break;\n      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });\n      const lines = buffer.split('\\n');\n      buffer = lines.pop() ?? '';\n\n      for (const line of lines) {\n        const trimmed = line.trim();\n        if (!trimmed.startsWith('data:')) continue;\n        try {\n          const evt = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(5)) as Record<string, unknown>;\n          switch (evt.event) {\n            case 'strategy': {\n              const seg = evt.segment as string;\n              for (const lang of params.audienceProfile.topLanguages) {\n                callbacks.onProgress(seg, lang, 'loading');\n              }\n              callbacks.onStrategy(seg, evt.strategy as string);\n              break;\n            }\n            case 'ai_decision': {\n              const seg = evt.segment as string;\n              const decisions = parseAIDecisions(evt.decisions as Record<string, unknown>);\n              callbacks.onAIDecision(seg, decisions);\n              break;\n            }\n            case 'content_ready':\n              callbacks.onProgress(evt.segment as string, evt.lang as string, 'done');\n              callbacks.onContentReady(\n                evt.segment as string,\n                evt.lang as string,\n                evt.data as ContentFields,\n              );\n              break;\n            case 'error':\n              callbacks.onProgress(\n                evt.segment as string,\n                (evt.lang as string) ?? 'unknown',\n                'error',\n              );\n              callbacks.onSegmentError?.(\n                evt.segment as string,\n                (evt.lang as string) ?? 'unknown',\n                (evt.message as string) ?? '生成失败',\n              );\n              break;\n            case 'done': {\n              const summary = evt.summary as { total: number; completed: number };\n              callbacks.onDone(summary.total, summary.completed);\n              break;\n            }\n          }\n        } catch {\n          // skip malformed SSE events\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (signal?.aborted) return;\n    callbacks.onError?.(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)));\n  }\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-marketing-agent\\SKILL.md",
 "contents": "---\nname: edm-marketing-agent\ndescription: >\n  EDM 邮件营销 AI Agent 的领域知识库与决策框架。涵盖意图检测、受众分层策略、\n  发送时机优化、内容模式标准和多语言本地化。当进行以下操作时触发：\n  (1) 创建或优化 EDM 营销活动——需要决定意图、语气、内容策略时；\n  (2) 修改 ai_service.py 或 audience_service.py 中的 prompt 逻辑时；\n  (3) 新增或调整 S/A/B/C 分层的营销策略时；\n  (4) 改进邮件内容质量、标题写作、CTA 设计时；\n  (5) 处理多语言翻译和本地化营销文案时；\n  (6) 讨论发送时机、频率控制、受众生命周期管理时。\n  产品上下文：TapNow 平台，使用 FastAPI 后端 + React 前端 + 多 AI Provider 架构。\n---\n\n# EDM Marketing Agent\n\n邮件营销领域知识库，为 AI Agent 自主决策提供结构化框架。\n\n## 核心架构\n\n``​`\nedm-backend/app/services/\n├── ai_service.py          # prompt 构建 + AI 调用（本 skill 的主要改进目标）\n├── audience_service.py    # 受众画像 + 生命周期检测\n├── campaign_service.py    # 活动 CRUD + 状态机\n├── send_service.py        # 发送执行 + 排期\n└── scheduler.py           # 定时任务轮询\n``​`\n\n受众分层：S（高价值付费活跃）/ A（活跃混合）/ B（免费为主低活跃）/ C（流失风险）\n\n生命周期阶段（`audience_service.LIFECYCLE_STAGES`）：\n`new_inactive` → `onboarding` → `active` → `power_user` → `declining` → `dormant` → `churned`\n\n## Workflow\n\n### 1. 创建营销活动\n\n完整的自主决策流程：\n\n1. **受众分析**：读取 `audience_service.build_audience_profile()` 输出，理解各分层特征\n   - 如需增强分析，运行 `scripts/analyze_audience.py`\n2. **意图决策**：参考 [intent-framework.md](references/intent-framework.md) 的决策树，基于 `(segment, lifecycle_stage)` 确定营销意图\n3. **时机选择**：参考 [timing-guide.md](references/timing-guide.md)，推荐发送时间窗口\n4. **内容策略**：参考 [segment-strategies.md](references/segment-strategies.md) 获取分层专属策略\n5. **内容生成**：参考 [content-patterns.md](references/content-patterns.md) 的模式与质量标准\n6. **本地化**：如涉及多语言，参考 [localization.md](references/localization.md) 进行适配\n\n### 2. 优化现有内容\n\n1. 用 [content-patterns.md](references/content-patterns.md) 中的质量评分维度诊断\n2. 对照 [segment-strategies.md](references/segment-strategies.md) 检查策略匹配度\n3. 重写或微调，确保意图-内容一致性\n\n### 3. 修改 Prompt / 后端逻辑\n\n修改 `ai_service.py` 中的 prompt 构建函数时：\n\n1. 先确认要改哪个环节（意图判断 / 语气选择 / 内容要求 / 输出格式）\n2. 参考对应 reference 文件获取领域知识\n3. 保持 prompt 与 `AUTONOMOUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA` 的结构兼容性\n4. 测试：确保 JSON 输出可被 `ContentFields` 和 `AIDecisions` 正确解析\n\n## 关键约束\n\n- **品牌名不翻译**：TapNow, Pro, Premium, Basic, Free, Enterprise\n- **输出格式**：严格 JSON，无 markdown 包裹，字段与 `AUTONOMOUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA` 一致\n- **CTA 文案**：≤ 8 字/词\n- **邮件标题**：≤ 15 字\n- **正文段落**：2-3 段，每段 50-100 字\n- **亮点条目**：3-5 条，每条 ≤ 20 字\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-marketing-agent\\references\\intent-framework.md",
 "contents": "# 意图检测决策框架\n\n## 意图类型定义\n\n| 意图 ID | 名称 | 核心目的 | 典型受众特征 |\n|---------|------|---------|-------------|\n| `new_user_onboarding` | 新用户引导 | 引导体验核心功能，降低上手门槛 | 注册 ≤14 天，活跃天数少 |\n| `churn_recall` | 流失召回 | 通过情感/优惠唤回长期不活跃用户 | 90+ 天未活跃 |\n| `upsell` | 付费转化 | 引导免费活跃用户升级为付费 | 活跃 + Free 计划 |\n| `feature_announcement` | 功能推广 | 向活跃用户推介新功能提升使用深度 | 活跃用户，不论付费状态 |\n| `retention` | 留存维护 | 增强付费用户黏性和忠诚度 | 活跃 + 付费计划 |\n| `win_back_declining` | 挽回下滑 | 发现下滑原因并针对性激活 | 7-30 天未活跃，曾经活跃 |\n\n## 决策树\n\n``​`\n输入: (segment, lifecycle_stage, paid_ratio, goal_hint)\n      │\n      ├─ goal_hint 非空？\n      │   └─ YES → 以 goal_hint 为主导意图，跳转到对应意图规则\n      │\n      ├─ lifecycle_stage == \"new_inactive\"\n      │   └─ → new_user_onboarding\n      │\n      ├─ lifecycle_stage == \"onboarding\"\n      │   └─ → new_user_onboarding（内容侧重进阶引导）\n      │\n      ├─ lifecycle_stage == \"churned\"\n      │   └─ → churn_recall\n      │\n      ├─ lifecycle_stage == \"dormant\"\n      │   └─ → churn_recall（语气更温和，强调\"我们想你了\"）\n      │\n      ├─ lifecycle_stage == \"declining\"\n      │   └─ → win_back_declining\n      │\n      ├─ lifecycle_stage == \"active\"\n      │   ├─ paid_ratio < 0.3 → upsell\n      │   ├─ paid_ratio ≥ 0.3 → feature_announcement\n      │   └─ (segment == \"S\") → retention\n      │\n      └─ lifecycle_stage == \"power_user\"\n          ├─ paid → retention\n          └─ free → upsell（强调 power user 值得升级）\n``​`\n\n## Segment × Lifecycle 推荐矩阵\n\n| | new_inactive | onboarding | active | power_user | declining | dormant | churned |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| **S** | onboarding | onboarding | retention | retention | win_back | churn_recall | churn_recall |\n| **A** | onboarding | onboarding | feature / upsell | retention / upsell | win_back | churn_recall | churn_recall |\n| **B** | onboarding | onboarding | upsell | upsell | win_back | churn_recall | churn_recall |\n| **C** | onboarding | onboarding | feature | upsell | win_back | churn_recall | churn_recall |\n\n说明：\n- 表中 `feature / upsell` 表示两者皆可，优先看 `paid_ratio` 决定\n- S 层 active/power_user 一律 retention，不做 upsell 以避免损害高端用户体验\n- C 层 active 优先 feature_announcement 而非 upsell，因为这批用户需要先建立产品价值认知\n\n## goal_hint 覆盖规则\n\n当运营人员提供 `goal_hint` 时，它对意图有强引导力：\n\n| goal_hint 关键词 | 映射意图 |\n|-----------------|---------|\n| 包含 \"新功能\"/\"上线\"/\"发布\"/\"launch\" | feature_announcement |\n| 包含 \"召回\"/\"回来\"/\"想你\"/\"miss\" | churn_recall |\n| 包含 \"升级\"/\"付费\"/\"pro\"/\"premium\" | upsell |\n| 包含 \"欢迎\"/\"引导\"/\"开始\" | new_user_onboarding |\n| 包含 \"感谢\"/\"周年\"/\"忠诚\" | retention |\n| 包含 \"优惠\"/\"折扣\"/\"限时\" | upsell（带紧迫感） |\n\n如果 goal_hint 与受众特征严重冲突（如对 churned 用户做 upsell），在 `strategy_reasoning` 中说明调整原因。\n\n## 意图 → 语气映射\n\n| 意图 | 推荐语气 | 备选语气 |\n|------|---------|---------|\n| new_user_onboarding | 轻松引导 | 专业友好 |\n| churn_recall | 温情关怀 | 轻松活泼 |\n| upsell | 紧迫促销 | 专业友好 |\n| feature_announcement | 轻松活泼 | 专业友好 |\n| retention | 专业友好 | 正式商务 |\n| win_back_declining | 温情关怀 | 轻松引导 |\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-marketing-agent\\references\\segment-strategies.md",
 "contents": "# S/A/B/C 分层策略库\n\n## S 层：高价值付费活跃用户\n\n### 画像\n- 付费率高（通常 >70%）\n- 活跃度高，平均活跃天数 <7 天\n- 主要处于 `active` 或 `power_user` 阶段\n- 主要订阅：Pro / Premium / Enterprise\n\n### 核心目标\n**留存维护 + 价值深化**：这批用户已是付费活跃用户，目标是加强黏性、提升 LTV、培养忠诚度。\n\n### 推荐语气\n- 首选：**专业友好**——尊享感、重视感\n- 备选：**正式商务**——适合 Enterprise 用户\n\n### CTA 策略\n- 方向：探索高级功能、独家内容、VIP 活动\n- 示例文案：`探索新功能` `立即体验` `查看专属权益`\n- 紧迫度：低——不要施压，用价值吸引\n- 不要用：限时优惠、打折促销（损害高端形象）\n\n### 邮件频率\n- 建议：每 2 周 1 次\n- 上限：每周 1 次\n- 特殊事件（新功能/产品更新）可额外发送\n\n### 避坑清单\n- 不要发折扣券——暗示产品不值原价\n- 不要用催促式语言——\"赶快\"、\"仅剩\"\n- 不要推荐基础功能——他们已经很熟悉\n- 不要群发无差别内容——体现个性化\n\n### 成功模式\n- \"作为 Pro 用户，您可以率先体验……\"\n- 强调效率提升和独家价值\n- 使用数据驱动叙事（\"您本月已完成 XX 个项目\"）\n\n---\n\n## A 层：活跃用户，付费与免费混合\n\n### 画像\n- 付费率中等（30-70%）\n- 活跃度较高\n- 混合 `active` 和 `power_user`\n- 计划分布广泛\n\n### 核心目标\n**功能推广 + 选择性转化**：推介功能深化使用，对免费用户适度引导升级。\n\n### 推荐语气\n- 首选：**轻松活泼**——亲切、有活力\n- 备选：**专业友好**——功能推广时\n\n### CTA 策略\n- 付费用户方向：新功能探索、使用技巧\n- 免费用户方向：功能受限时的升级引导\n- 示例文案：`免费试试看` `了解更多` `开启高级功能`\n- 紧迫度：中——可用限时试用，但不要过度施压\n\n### 邮件频率\n- 建议：每 10 天 1 次\n- 上限：每周 1 次\n\n### 避坑清单\n- 不要假设所有人都是付费用户\n- 不要把升级推销作为唯一主题\n- 不要使用过于正式的语言——保持亲切\n\n### 成功模式\n- 先展示功能价值，再自然引出升级\n- \"很多像您一样的用户发现……\"\n- 社交证明 + 具体使用场景\n\n---\n\n## B 层：以免费用户为主，近期活跃度偏低\n\n### 画像\n- 付费率低（<30%）\n- 活跃度偏低，平均活跃天数 8-30 天\n- 混合 `declining` 和 `active`\n- 主要 Free 计划\n\n### 核心目标\n**激活 + 价值教育**：帮助他们发现产品价值，建立使用习惯，远期目标是转化。\n\n### 推荐语气\n- 首选：**轻松引导**——降低门槛、消除顾虑\n- 备选：**温情关怀**——对 declining 用户\n\n### CTA 策略\n- 方向：回来看看、一步操作、快速上手\n- 示例文案：`回来看看` `1 分钟开始` `免费探索`\n- 紧迫度：低——不要催促，降低行动成本\n- 不要用：付费相关 CTA\n\n### 邮件频率\n- 建议：每 2 周 1 次\n- 上限：每 10 天 1 次\n- 注意：频率过高会导致退订\n\n### 避坑清单\n- **不要推销付费**——他们还没感受到产品价值\n- 不要发复杂功能介绍——他们还在初级阶段\n- 不要用专业术语——保持简单\n- 不要发太长的邮件——简短有效\n\n### 成功模式\n- 一封邮件只解决一个问题\n- \"只需 3 步就能……\"\n- 展示其他免费用户的成功故事\n- Quick win——让他们快速获得成就感\n\n---\n\n## C 层：流失风险用户，极低活跃度\n\n### 画像\n- 活跃度极低，30+ 天未活跃\n- 主要处于 `dormant` 或 `churned` 阶段\n- 计划分布不定（可能有历史付费用户）\n\n### 核心目标\n**召回 + 重建连接**：温和唤回，不施压，提供回来的理由。\n\n### 推荐语气\n- 首选：**温情关怀**——\"我们想你了\"\n- 备选：**轻松活泼**——轻松氛围降低回归压力\n\n### CTA 策略\n- 方向：一键回来、看看有什么新的\n- 示例文案：`回来看看` `查看新变化` `重新开始`\n- 紧迫度：低——绝对不要催促\n- 可选：对曾经付费用户提供回归优惠\n\n### 邮件频率\n- 建议：每月 1 次\n- 上限：每 2 周 1 次\n- 连续 3 次无互动后降低频率或停发\n\n### 避坑清单\n- **绝对不要强推付费**——他们连产品都不用了\n- 不要发太多封——会被标记为垃圾邮件\n- 不要用内疚感话术\n- 不要假设他们记得产品细节\n\n### 成功模式\n- \"自从您上次使用后，我们有了这些改变……\"\n- 展示产品进步，而非用户缺席\n- 提供无风险回归路径（免费、不绑定）\n- 对曾经付费用户：\"我们为老用户准备了……\"\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-marketing-agent\\references\\timing-guide.md",
 "contents": "# 发送时机优化指南\n\n## 按意图推荐时间窗口\n\n| 意图 | 最佳发送日 | 最佳时段（收件人本地时间） | 理由 |\n|------|----------|----------------------|------|\n| new_user_onboarding | 注册后 1-3 天内 | 10:00-11:00 | 趁热打铁，注册记忆尚新 |\n| churn_recall | 周二/周三 | 14:00-16:00 | 工作日下午空闲期，适合重新审视 |\n| upsell | 周二/周四 | 10:00-11:00 | 工作效率高峰期，决策意愿强 |\n| feature_announcement | 周一/周二 | 09:00-10:00 | 周初开始新一周，适合接受新事物 |\n| retention | 周三/周五 | 11:00-12:00 | 周中或周末前，情绪较放松 |\n| win_back_declining | 周二/周三 | 15:00-17:00 | 下午时段，工作间隙关注邮件 |\n\n## 时区策略\n\n受众 `top_languages` 可推断主要时区分布：\n\n| 语言 | 推测时区 | UTC 偏移 |\n|------|---------|---------|\n| zh-CN | 亚洲/上海 | +8 |\n| zh-TW | 亚洲/台北 | +8 |\n| ja | 亚洲/东京 | +9 |\n| ko | 亚洲/首尔 | +9 |\n| en | 多时区（默认 UTC-5 美东） | -5 |\n| de/fr/es/it | 欧洲/中欧 | +1 |\n| pt | 美洲/圣保罗 | -3 |\n| ar | 亚洲/利雅得 | +3 |\n| th | 亚洲/曼谷 | +7 |\n| vi | 亚洲/胡志明 | +7 |\n| id/ms | 亚洲/雅加达 | +7 |\n| ru | 欧洲/莫斯科 | +3 |\n\n### 多时区处理\n\n当受众跨越 3+ 个时区时：\n1. 按时区分组发送（理想方案）\n2. 如不支持分组，选择覆盖最多受众的时间段\n3. 避免任何时区的凌晨 0:00-7:00\n\n## 频率控制规则\n\n### 全局规则\n- 同一用户 48 小时内不重复发送\n- 同一用户每月最多 4 封营销邮件\n- 用户已退订的不发送（`unsubscribe_service` 负责）\n\n### 分层频率上限\n\n| 分层 | 最小间隔 | 月度上限 | 说明 |\n|------|---------|---------|------|\n| S | 7 天 | 4 封 | 高价值用户可容忍较高频率 |\n| A | 7 天 | 3 封 | 适度频率 |\n| B | 10 天 | 2 封 | 低活跃用户需控制频率 |\n| C | 14 天 | 1 封 | 流失用户过度发送会触发退订/垃圾标记 |\n\n### 退避机制\n- 连续 2 封未打开：下次发送间隔 ×1.5\n- 连续 3 封未打开：下次发送间隔 ×2\n- 连续 5 封未打开：暂停发送 30 天\n\n## 与 `audience_service` 数据联动\n\n`build_behavioral_signals()` 返回的字段可辅助时机判断：\n\n| 字段 | 时机决策用途 |\n|------|------------|\n| `median_active_days_ago` | 值大 → 不宜立即发，需等合适时段 |\n| `active_pct` | >50% → 可按正常节奏发；<20% → 延长间隔 |\n| `churned_pct` | >30% → 采用召回时间窗口（下午时段） |\n| `new_inactive_pct` | >15% → 优先安排 onboarding 邮件（注册后 1-3 天） |\n\n## 特殊时段规避\n\n- 当地公共假期前一天和假期当天不发\n- 周末避免发送商务性质邮件（retention/upsell）\n- 节日期间可发温情关怀类（retention）\n- 大促期间（黑五、双11）可提高 upsell 频率\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-marketing-agent\\references\\content-patterns.md",
 "contents": "# 内容模式与质量标准\n\n## 按意图的内容模式\n\n### new_user_onboarding — 新用户引导\n\n**结构**：\n``​`\ngreeting: 欢迎 + 称赞选择\nintro_line: 简述产品核心价值（1 句）\nbody_paragraphs:\n  - P1: 第一步该做什么（降低门槛，具体操作）\n  - P2: 做完后能获得什么（即时价值）\nhighlight_title: \"快速开始\" 类\nhighlight_items: 3 个最关键的入门步骤\ncta_text: 动作导向（\"开始使用\"、\"创建第一个XX\"）\nclosing_text: 鼓励 + 提供帮助\n``​`\n\n**示例标题公式**：\n- `欢迎加入 TapNow！这是你的第一步`\n- `3 分钟上手 TapNow`\n- `你的 TapNow 之旅从这里开始`\n\n---\n\n### churn_recall — 流失召回\n\n**结构**：\n``​`\ngreeting: 温暖称呼（不要用\"亲爱的用户\"这种泛称）\nintro_line: 表达想念 + 提及时间跨度（\"好久不见\"）\nbody_paragraphs:\n  - P1: 自上次以来产品的重要更新（3 个以内）\n  - P2: 回来后能立即获得的价值\nhighlight_title: \"这段时间我们有了这些变化\" 类\nhighlight_items: 3-4 个产品改进点\ncta_text: 低压力（\"回来看看\"、\"了解新变化\"）\nclosing_text: 温情收尾，不施压\n``​`\n\n**示例标题公式**：\n- `TapNow 有了新变化，来看看？`\n- `我们想你了——TapNow 新功能上线`\n- `好久不见，TapNow 准备了这些给你`\n\n---\n\n### upsell — 付费转化\n\n**结构**：\n``​`\ngreeting: 友好称呼\nintro_line: 认可使用成果 + 引出升级机会\nbody_paragraphs:\n  - P1: 用户当前场景中的限制/痛点\n  - P2: 升级后的具体解决方案 + 核心收益\nhighlight_title: \"升级解锁\" / \"Pro 专属\" 类\nhighlight_items: 3-5 个升级后独有功能\ncta_text: 行动导向（\"立即升级\"、\"开启 Pro\"、\"免费试用 7 天\"）\nclosing_text: 限时优惠（如有）+ 无压力关闭\n``​`\n\n**示例标题公式**：\n- `解锁 TapNow Pro，效率提升 3 倍`\n- `你的使用量已超 80%，升级不受限`\n- `限时：Pro 首月半价`\n\n---\n\n### feature_announcement — 功能推广\n\n**结构**：\n``​`\ngreeting: 简短问候\nintro_line: 直接宣布新功能（制造兴奋感）\nbody_paragraphs:\n  - P1: 新功能能解决什么问题\n  - P2: 怎么使用（简明步骤）\nhighlight_title: 新功能名称\nhighlight_items: 3-4 个功能亮点\ncta_text: 体验导向（\"立即体验\"、\"试试看\"）\nclosing_text: 期待反馈\n``​`\n\n**示例标题公式**：\n- `全新 XX 功能上线！`\n- `TapNow 新增 XX，你一定会喜欢`\n- `你要求的功能来了：XX`\n\n---\n\n### retention — 留存维护\n\n**结构**：\n``​`\ngreeting: 带尊享感的称呼\nintro_line: 认可用户价值/使用成果\nbody_paragraphs:\n  - P1: 个性化使用数据或成就\n  - P2: 深度功能/技巧推荐\nhighlight_title: \"专属推荐\" / \"本月亮点\" 类\nhighlight_items: 3 个提升效率的技巧或隐藏功能\ncta_text: 探索导向（\"探索更多\"、\"查看报告\"）\nclosing_text: 感谢 + 品牌认同\n``​`\n\n---\n\n### win_back_declining — 挽回下滑\n\n**结构**：\n``​`\ngreeting: 关切的称呼\nintro_line: 不直说\"你不活跃了\"，而是\"有一些你可能感兴趣的\"\nbody_paragraphs:\n  - P1: 近期产品改进中与用户相关的\n  - P2: 一个低门槛的重启建议\nhighlight_title: \"为你准备的更新\" 类\nhighlight_items: 2-3 个针对性改进\ncta_text: 低压力（\"来看看\"、\"重新开始\"）\nclosing_text: 开放态度，不施压\n``​`\n\n## 标题写作公式\n\n### 六种标题模式\n\n1. **好奇心驱动**：`TapNow 的这个秘密功能，90% 的人不知道`\n2. **利益驱动**：`用 TapNow 节省 50% 的工作时间`\n3. **紧迫感**：`限时 48 小时：Pro 首月半价`（仅用于 upsell）\n4. **情感连接**：`好久不见，TapNow 想你了`（仅用于 recall）\n5. **成就认可**：`你本月完成了 30 个项目！`（用于 retention）\n6. **问题导向**：`还在手动做 XX？试试这个`\n\n### 标题质量清单\n\n- [ ] ≤ 15 字\n- [ ] 包含明确的价值主张或情感钩子\n- [ ] 避免全大写或过多感叹号\n- [ ] 品牌名使用英文原名\n- [ ] 不使用垃圾邮件触发词（\"免费\"单独用、\"赚钱\"、\"中奖\"）\n\n## 质量评分维度\n\n对生成的邮件内容，按以下 5 个维度评分（1-5 分）：\n\n| 维度 | 1 分 | 3 分 | 5 分 |\n|------|------|------|------|\n| **意图匹配** | 内容与检测意图无关 | 大方向对但不够聚焦 | 每句话都服务于意图 |\n| **受众适配** | 无差别通用内容 | 考虑了分层但不够深入 | 精准匹配分层特征和生命周期 |\n| **CTA 强度** | 无 CTA 或模糊 | 有 CTA 但缺乏吸引力 | CTA 简短有力且与意图一致 |\n| **可读性** | 段落冗长、结构混乱 | 基本通顺 | 节奏明快、信息层次清晰 |\n| **情感连接** | 机械生硬 | 有一定温度 | 让用户感到被理解和重视 |\n\n总分 ≥ 20 分为合格，≥ 23 分为优秀。\n\n## 正文节奏控制\n\n``​`\nintro_line     → 钩子（引发兴趣或共鸣，1-2 句）\nbody P1        → 痛点/机会（切入用户场景，50-80 字）\nbody P2        → 解决方案/价值（展示产品如何帮助，50-100 字）\nhighlight      → 具体亮点（信息密度高，快速扫描）\ncta_text       → 行动（一个明确动作）\nclosing_text   → 收尾（温暖/期待，不超过 2 句）\n``​`\n\n每个段落独立承担一个信息功能，不要在一段中混入多个目的。\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-marketing-agent\\references\\localization.md",
 "contents": "# 多语言本地化指南\n\n## 通用翻译原则\n\n1. **品牌名不翻译**：TapNow, Pro, Premium, Basic, Free, Enterprise 保持英文\n2. **意译优先**：保持营销感染力，不要直译\n3. **CTA 简短**：翻译后仍需 ≤ 8 字/词\n4. **结构不变**：JSON 键名不动，只翻译 value\n5. **send_date / team_name 不翻译**\n\n## 各语言营销文化指南\n\n### 日本語 (ja)\n\n**敬语体系**：\n- 使用 です・ます 调（丁寧語）\n- 「〜していただけます」「〜をお届けします」\n- 避免 タメ語（过于随意的表达）\n\n**营销文化偏好**：\n- 重视细节和品质描述\n- 数据和实证比情感诉求更有效\n- 含蓄表达优于直接推销\n- 限定感（「期間限定」「先着〇名」）比折扣更有吸引力\n\n**CTA 本地化**：\n- `立即体验` → `今すぐ体験する`\n- `了解更多` → `詳しく見る`\n- `开始使用` → `使い始める`\n- `免费试用` → `無料で試す`\n\n**禁忌**：\n- 避免过于直接的金钱表述\n- 不要用中文汉字替代日语汉字（如「龍」vs「竜」）\n\n---\n\n### 한국어 (ko)\n\n**敬语体系**：\n- 使用 합쇼체 或 해요체\n- 해라체 绝对不用于营销邮件\n\n**营销文化偏好**：\n- 社交证明非常有效（\"100 万用户的选择\"）\n- 韩流文化影响：适度使用流行语可拉近距离\n- 技术产品营销可更直接\n\n**CTA 本地化**：\n- `立即体验` → `지금 바로 체험하기`\n- `了解更多` → `더 알아보기`\n- `免费试用` → `무료로 시작하기`\n\n**禁忌**：\n- 外来语使用韩国通用表记法\n- 避免日式表达\n\n---\n\n### Français (fr)\n\n**称谓体系**：\n- 使用 vous（您），不用 tu\n- 正式但不僵硬\n\n**营销文化偏好**：\n- 注重优雅和品味\n- 文化引用比数据更有共鸣\n- 适度的幽默感受欢迎\n\n**排版规则**：\n- 冒号、分号、叹号、问号前加空格（`:` `;` `!` `?`）\n- 使用法语引号 « »\n\n**CTA 本地化**：\n- `立即体验` → `Découvrir maintenant`\n- `了解更多` → `En savoir plus`\n- `免费试用` → `Essayer gratuitement`\n\n---\n\n### Deutsch (de)\n\n**称谓体系**：\n- 使用 Sie（您）\n- 商务语境严格使用敬称\n\n**营销文化偏好**：\n- 重视逻辑和效率\n- 数据和技术规格比情感更有说服力\n- 严谨 > 花哨\n\n**语言特点**：\n- 注意复合词拼写\n- 名词首字母大写\n\n**CTA 本地化**：\n- `立即体验` → `Jetzt entdecken`\n- `了解更多` → `Mehr erfahren`\n- `免费试用` → `Kostenlos testen`\n\n---\n\n### Español (es)\n\n**称谓体系**：\n- 使用 usted（正式）\n- 使用中性西班牙语，避免过度地区化\n\n**营销文化偏好**：\n- 温暖、热情的语气受欢迎\n- 家庭和社区概念有共鸣\n- 适度的情感表达是加分项\n\n**CTA 本地化**：\n- `立即体验` → `Descubrir ahora`\n- `了解更多` → `Saber más`\n- `免费试用` → `Probar gratis`\n\n---\n\n### 繁體中文 (zh-TW)\n\n**词汇差异**（与 zh-CN）：\n- 软件 → 軟體\n- 用户 → 使用者\n- 视频 → 影片\n- 信息 → 資訊\n- 网络 → 網路\n\n**营销文化偏好**：\n- 语气亲切专业\n- 台湾受众对日韩文化元素接受度高\n- 可适度使用台式口语增加亲切感\n\n**CTA 本地化**：\n- `立即体验` → `立即體驗`\n- `了解更多` → `瞭解更多`\n\n---\n\n### العربية (ar)\n\n**方向**：RTL（从右到左），确保邮件模板支持\n\n**称谓体系**：\n- 使用正式的阿拉伯语敬语\n\n**营销文化偏好**：\n- 尊重文化和宗教敏感性\n- 家庭导向的价值观\n- 避免过度直接的商业化表达\n\n**CTA 本地化**：\n- `立即体验` → `اكتشف الآن`\n- `了解更多` → `اعرف المزيد`\n\n**禁忌**：\n- 品牌名保持英文\n- 注意数字格式（使用阿拉伯数字 0-9，非东阿拉伯数字）\n\n---\n\n### 东南亚语言 (th/vi/id/ms)\n\n**共通特点**：\n- 语气友好、尊重\n- 社交证明和折扣都有效\n- 移动端阅读为主，内容要更简短\n\n**泰语 (th)**：使用 ครับ/ค่ะ 敬语词尾\n\n**越南语 (vi)**：使用 bạn（你）或 quý khách（贵客）\n\n**印尼语/马来语 (id/ms)**：使用 Anda（您）\n\n---\n\n### Русский (ru)\n\n**称谓**：使用 Вы（大写，表尊敬）\n\n**营销偏好**：\n- 技术产品可使用较直接的风格\n- 数据驱动的论证有效\n- 适度幽默可以接受\n\n---\n\n### Italiano (it) / Português (pt)\n\n**意大利语**：使用 Lei（正式的 \"您\"），语气热情但专业\n\n**葡萄牙语**：\n- 巴西葡语（主要市场）：使用 você，语气可稍随意\n- 葡萄牙葡语：使用 o senhor / a senhora，更正式\n- 默认使用巴西葡语\n"
}

 "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Audience analysis enhancement for EDM marketing.\n\nExtends audience_service.build_audience_profile() with:\n- Intent recommendation per segment\n- Timing suggestion based on audience composition\n- Content strategy hints\n\nUsage (from edm-backend root, with venv activated):\n    python -m scripts.analyze_audience <recipient_list_id>\n\nOr import as a library:\n    from scripts.analyze_audience import recommend_intent, suggest_timing\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport sys\nfrom typing import Any\n\nLIFECYCLE_STAGES = {\n    \"new_inactive\": \"注册后未实质使用\",\n    \"onboarding\": \"新手探索期\",\n    \"active\": \"活跃使用中\",\n    \"power_user\": \"高频深度用户\",\n    \"declining\": \"使用频率下降\",\n    \"dormant\": \"长期沉默\",\n    \"churned\": \"已流失\",\n}\n\nINTENT_PRIORITY = {\n    \"new_inactive\": \"new_user_onboarding\",\n    \"onboarding\": \"new_user_onboarding\",\n    \"active\": \"feature_announcement\",\n    \"power_user\": \"retention\",\n    \"declining\": \"win_back_declining\",\n    \"dormant\": \"churn_recall\",\n    \"churned\": \"churn_recall\",\n}\n\nTONE_MAP = {\n    \"new_user_onboarding\": \"轻松引导\",\n    \"churn_recall\": \"温情关怀\",\n    \"upsell\": \"紧迫促销\",\n    \"feature_announcement\": \"轻松活泼\",\n    \"retention\": \"专业友好\",\n    \"win_back_declining\": \"温情关怀\",\n}\n\nTIMING_WINDOWS = {\n    \"new_user_onboarding\": {\"day\": \"注册后1-3天\", \"hour\": \"10:00-11:00\"},\n    \"churn_recall\": {\"day\": \"周二/周三\", \"hour\": \"14:00-16:00\"},\n    \"upsell\": {\"day\": \"周二/周四\", \"hour\": \"10:00-11:00\"},\n    \"feature_announcement\": {\"day\": \"周一/周二\", \"hour\": \"09:00-10:00\"},\n    \"retention\": {\"day\": \"周三/周五\", \"hour\": \"11:00-12:00\"},\n    \"win_back_declining\": {\"day\": \"周二/周三\", \"hour\": \"15:00-17:00\"},\n}\n\n\ndef recommend_intent(\n    segment: str,\n    dominant_lifecycle: str,\n    paid_ratio: float,\n    goal_hint: str = \"\",\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Recommend marketing intent for a segment based on lifecycle and payment data.\n\n    Returns dict with: intent, tone, reasoning, confidence (0-1).\n    \"\"\"\n    if goal_hint:\n        hint_lower = goal_hint.lower()\n        hint_map = {\n            \"new_user_onboarding\": [\"新功能\", \"上线\", \"发布\", \"launch\"],\n            \"churn_recall\": [\"召回\", \"回来\", \"想你\", \"miss\"],\n            \"upsell\": [\"升级\", \"付费\", \"pro\", \"premium\", \"优惠\", \"折扣\", \"限时\"],\n            \"new_user_onboarding\": [\"欢迎\", \"引导\", \"开始\"],\n            \"retention\": [\"感谢\", \"周年\", \"忠诚\"],\n        }\n        for intent, keywords in hint_map.items():\n            if any(kw in hint_lower for kw in keywords):\n                return {\n                    \"intent\": intent,\n                    \"tone\": TONE_MAP.get(intent, \"专业友好\"),\n                    \"reasoning\": f\"基于运营提示 '{goal_hint}' 匹配\",\n                    \"confidence\": 0.9,\n                    \"source\": \"goal_hint\",\n                }\n\n    base_intent = INTENT_PRIORITY.get(dominant_lifecycle, \"feature_announcement\")\n\n    if dominant_lifecycle == \"active\" and segment != \"S\":\n        if paid_ratio < 0.3:\n            base_intent = \"upsell\"\n        else:\n            base_intent = \"feature_announcement\"\n    elif dominant_lifecycle == \"power_user\":\n        base_intent = \"retention\" if paid_ratio > 0.5 else \"upsell\"\n    elif dominant_lifecycle in (\"active\", \"power_user\") and segment == \"S\":\n        base_intent = \"retention\"\n\n    confidence = 0.8\n    if dominant_lifecycle in (\"churned\", \"new_inactive\"):\n        confidence = 0.95\n\n    return {\n        \"intent\": base_intent,\n        \"tone\": TONE_MAP.get(base_intent, \"专业友好\"),\n        \"reasoning\": f\"分层{segment}/{LIFECYCLE_STAGES.get(dominant_lifecycle, dominant_lifecycle)} → {base_intent}\",\n        \"confidence\": confidence,\n        \"source\": \"decision_tree\",\n    }\n\n\ndef suggest_timing(intent: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return recommended send timing for the given intent.\"\"\"\n    return TIMING_WINDOWS.get(intent, {\"day\": \"周二\", \"hour\": \"10:00-11:00\"})\n\n\ndef score_content(\n    content: dict[str, Any],\n    intent: str,\n    segment: str,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Score email content quality (heuristic, not AI-based).\n\n    Returns dict with dimension scores (1-5) and total.\n    \"\"\"\n    scores: dict[str, int] = {}\n\n    title = content.get(\"email_title\", \"\")\n    scores[\"title_length\"] = 5 if 0 < len(title) <= 15 else (3 if len(title) <= 20 else 1)\n\n    cta = content.get(\"cta_text\", \"\")\n    scores[\"cta_length\"] = 5 if 0 < len(cta) <= 8 else (3 if len(cta) <= 12 else 1)\n\n    paragraphs = content.get(\"body_paragraphs\", [])\n    if 2 <= len(paragraphs) <= 3:\n        avg_len = sum(len(p) for p in paragraphs) / len(paragraphs) if paragraphs else 0\n        scores[\"body_structure\"] = 5 if 50 <= avg_len <= 100 else 3\n    else:\n        scores[\"body_structure\"] = 2\n\n    items = content.get(\"highlight_items\", [])\n    scores[\"highlights\"] = 5 if 3 <= len(items) <= 5 else (3 if items else 1)\n\n    has_greeting = bool(content.get(\"greeting\"))\n    has_closing = bool(content.get(\"closing_text\"))\n    scores[\"completeness\"] = 5 if (has_greeting and has_closing) else 3\n\n    total = sum(scores.values())\n    max_total = len(scores) * 5\n\n    return {\n        \"scores\": scores,\n        \"total\": total,\n        \"max\": max_total,\n        \"percentage\": round(total / max_total * 100),\n        \"verdict\": \"优秀\" if total >= max_total * 0.9 else (\"合格\" if total >= max_total * 0.7 else \"需改进\"),\n    }\n\n\ndef analyze_segment_profile(profile: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Produce a full analysis for one segment profile.\n\n    Expects a dict with: segment, count, paid_ratio, character_summary,\n    lifecycle_distribution, goal_hint (optional).\n    \"\"\"\n    segment = profile.get(\"segment\", \"A\")\n    paid_ratio = profile.get(\"paid_ratio\", 0.0)\n    lifecycle_dist = profile.get(\"lifecycle_distribution\", {})\n    goal_hint = profile.get(\"goal_hint\", \"\")\n\n    dominant = max(lifecycle_dist, key=lambda k: lifecycle_dist[k]) if lifecycle_dist else \"active\"\n\n    rec = recommend_intent(segment, dominant, paid_ratio, goal_hint)\n    timing = suggest_timing(rec[\"intent\"])\n\n    return {\n        \"segment\": segment,\n        \"dominant_lifecycle\": dominant,\n        \"recommendation\": rec,\n        \"timing\": timing,\n    }\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    \"\"\"CLI: read JSON profiles from stdin or file, output analysis.\"\"\"\n    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] != \"-\":\n        with open(sys.argv[1], encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            data = json.load(f)\n    else:\n        data = json.load(sys.stdin)\n\n    profiles = data if isinstance(data, list) else [data]\n    results = [analyze_segment_profile(p) for p in profiles]\n    print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

↓
Return tool result to AI
↓
AI generates final content
```

Frontend Admin Panel → API → CRUD on knowledge files (YAML/JSON)
```

data.get(\"choices\")\n        if not choices:\n            raise ValueError(f\"AI API returned empty choices: {data}\")\n        return ChatResponse.from_openai(choices[0])\n\n    async def close(self) -> None:\n        await self._client.aclose()\n"
}
```

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\app\\agent\\executor.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"AgentExecutor — runs a tool-calling loop over an AI provider.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Awaitable\n\nfrom app.agent.models import AgentResult, ChatResponse, ToolResult\nfrom app.ai_providers.base import AIProvider\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nToolFunction = Callable[..., Awaitable[str] | str]\n\n\nclass Tool:\n    \"\"\"A callable tool the agent can invoke via function calling.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        description: str,\n        parameters: dict,\n        func: ToolFunction,\n    ):\n        self.name = name\n        self.description = description\n        self.parameters = parameters\n        self.func = func\n\n    @property\n    def schema(self) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"OpenAI-compatible tool schema.\"\"\"\n        return {\n            \"type\": \"function\",\n            \"function\": {\n                \"name\": self.name,\n                \"description\": self.description,\n                \"parameters\": self.parameters,\n            },\n        }\n\n    async def execute(self, arguments: dict) -> str:\n        result = self.func(**arguments)\n        if hasattr(result, \"__await__\"):\n            result = await result\n        if not isinstance(result, str):\n            result = json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n        return result\n\n\nclass AgentExecutor:\n    \"\"\"Runs a multi-turn tool-calling loop.\n\n    1. Sends system + user messages along with tool schemas to the provider.\n    2. If the AI returns tool_calls, executes them and feeds results back.\n    3. Repeats until the AI returns a plain text response or max_iterations is reached.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        provider: AIProvider,\n        tools: list[Tool],\n        max_iterations: int = 5,\n        temperature: float = 0.7,\n        max_tokens: int = 4096,\n    ):\n        self.provider = provider\n        self.tools = {t.name: t for t in tools}\n        self.tool_schemas = [t.schema for t in tools]\n        self.max_iterations = max_iterations\n        self.temperature = temperature\n        self.max_tokens = max_tokens\n\n    async def run(\n        self,\n        system_prompt: str,\n        user_prompt: str,\n        *,\n        temperature: float | None = None,\n        max_tokens: int | None = None,\n    ) -> AgentResult:\n        messages: list[dict] = [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": system_prompt},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_prompt},\n        ]\n        tool_calls_log: list[dict] = []\n        temp = temperature if temperature is not None else self.temperature\n        tokens = max_tokens if max_tokens is not None else self.max_tokens\n\n        for iteration in range(self.max_iterations):\n            response: ChatResponse = await self.provider.chat_completion_with_tools(\n                messages,\n                tools=self.tool_schemas if self.tool_schemas else None,\n                temperature=temp,\n                max_tokens=tokens,\n            )\n\n            if not response.has_tool_calls():\n                return AgentResult(\n                    content=response.content or \"\",\n                    tool_calls_log=tool_calls_log,\n                    iterations=iteration + 1,\n                )\n\n            messages.append(response.to_assistant_message())\n\n            for tc in response.tool_calls:\n                tool = self.tools.get(tc.name)\n                if tool is None:\n                    logger.warning(\"Agent called unknown tool: %s\", tc.name)\n                    result_content = json.dumps(\n                        {\"error\": f\"Unknown tool: {tc.name}\"},\n                        ensure_ascii=False,\n                    )\n                else:\n                    try:\n                        result_content = await tool.execute(tc.arguments)\n                    except Exception as exc:\n                        logger.error(\"Tool %s execution failed: %s\", tc.name, exc)\n                        result_content = json.dumps(\n                            {\"error\": f\"Tool execution failed: {exc}\"},\n                            ensure_ascii=False,\n                        )\n\n                tool_calls_log.append({\n                    \"iteration\": iteration + 1,\n                    \"tool\": tc.name,\n                    \"arguments\": tc.arguments,\n                    \"result_preview\": result_content[:200],\n                })\n\n                tool_result = ToolResult(tool_call_id=tc.id, content=result_content)\n                messages.append(tool_result.to_message())\n\n            logger.info(\n                \"Agent iteration %d/%d: executed %d tool(s)\",\n                iteration + 1, self.max_iterations, len(response.tool_calls),\n            )\n\n        final = await self.provider.chat_completion_with_tools(\n            messages, tools=None, temperature=temp, max_tokens=tokens,\n        )\n        return AgentResult(\n            content=final.content or \"\",\n            tool_calls_log=tool_calls_log,\n            iterations=self.max_iterations,\n        )\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\app\\agent\\skills\\loader.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"YAML Knowledge Loader — loads and caches all knowledge files at startup,\nsupports hot-reload via reload() or API trigger.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport yaml\n\nfrom app.config import settings\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass KnowledgeStore:\n    \"\"\"In-memory knowledge store backed by YAML files on disk.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, knowledge_dir: str | Path | None = None):\n        self._dir = Path(knowledge_dir or settings.KNOWLEDGE_DIR).resolve()\n        self._data: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}\n        self._file_mtimes: dict[str, float] = {}\n\n    @property\n    def knowledge_dir(self) -> Path:\n        return self._dir\n\n    def load(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Scan the knowledge directory and load all YAML files.\"\"\"\n        if not self._dir.exists():\n            logger.warning(\"Knowledge directory does not exist: %s\", self._dir)\n            return\n\n        count = 0\n        for yaml_path in self._dir.rglob(\"*.yaml\"):\n            self._load_file(yaml_path)\n            count += 1\n        logger.info(\"Loaded %d knowledge files from %s\", count, self._dir)\n\n    def reload(self) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Reload all files, returning the number of files that changed.\"\"\"\n        if not self._dir.exists():\n            return 0\n        changed = 0\n        current_keys: set[str] = set()\n        for yaml_path in self._dir.rglob(\"*.yaml\"):\n            key = self._path_to_key(yaml_path)\n            current_keys.add(key)\n            mtime = yaml_path.stat().st_mtime\n            if key not in self._file_mtimes or self._file_mtimes[key] != mtime:\n                self._load_file(yaml_path)\n                changed += 1\n\n        removed = set(self._data.keys()) - current_keys\n        for key in removed:\n            del self._data[key]\n            del self._file_mtimes[key]\n            changed += 1\n\n        if changed:\n            logger.info(\"Knowledge reload: %d file(s) changed\", changed)\n        return changed\n\n    def _path_to_key(self, path: Path) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Convert a file path to a storage key like 'segments/S' or 'decision_tree'.\"\"\"\n        rel = path.relative_to(self._dir)\n        return str(rel.with_suffix(\"\")).replace(os.sep, \"/\")\n\n    def _load_file(self, path: Path) -> None:\n        key = self._path_to_key(path)\n        try:\n            text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n            data = yaml.safe_load(text) or {}\n            self._data[key] = data\n            self._file_mtimes[key] = path.stat().st_mtime\n        except Exception:\n            logger.exception(\"Failed to load knowledge file: %s\", path)\n\n    def get(self, key: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:\n        \"\"\"Get a knowledge entry by key (e.g. 'segments/S', 'intents/upsell').\"\"\"\n        return self._data.get(key)\n\n    def get_category(self, category: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Get all entries under a category (e.g. 'segments' -> {'S': {...}, 'A': {...}}).\"\"\"\n        prefix = category + \"/\"\n        return {\n            k[len(prefix):]: v\n            for k, v in self._data.items()\n            if k.startswith(prefix)\n        }\n\n    def list_keys(self) -> list[str]:\n        return sorted(self._data.keys())\n\n    def list_categories(self) -> list[str]:\n        cats: set[str] = set()\n        for key in self._data:\n            if \"/\" in key:\n                cats.add(key.split(\"/\")[0])\n            else:\n                cats.add(\"_root\")\n        return sorted(cats)\n\n    def list_entries(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"List all entries with metadata for the API.\"\"\"\n        entries = []\n        for key, data in sorted(self._data.items()):\n            parts = key.split(\"/\", 1)\n            category = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else \"_root\"\n            name = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else parts[0]\n            entries.append({\n                \"key\": key,\n                \"category\": category,\n                \"name\": name,\n                \"label\": data.get(\"label\") or data.get(\"name\") or data.get(\"language\") or name,\n                \"description\": data.get(\"description\") or data.get(\"purpose\") or \"\",\n            })\n        return entries\n\n    def get_raw_yaml(self, key: str) -> str | None:\n        \"\"\"Read the raw YAML text for a given key.\"\"\"\n        path = self._dir / (key + \".yaml\")\n        if path.exists():\n            return path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        return None\n\n    def write_yaml(self, key: str, content: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write YAML content to a file and update the cache.\"\"\"\n        path = self._dir / (key + \".yaml\")\n        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        path.write_text(content, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        self._load_file(path)\n\n    def delete_entry(self, key: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Delete a knowledge file and remove from cache.\"\"\"\n        path = self._dir / (key + \".yaml\")\n        if path.exists():\n            path.unlink()\n            self._data.pop(key, None)\n            self._file_mtimes.pop(key, None)\n            return True\n        return False\n\n    def format_as_text(self, key: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Format a knowledge entry as human-readable text for tool responses.\"\"\"\n        data = self.get(key)\n        if data is None:\n            return f\"知识条目 '{key}' 不存在\"\n        return yaml.dump(data, allow_unicode=True, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False)\n\n\n_store: KnowledgeStore | None = None\n\n\ndef get_knowledge_store() -> KnowledgeStore:\n    global _store\n    if _store is None:\n        _store = KnowledgeStore()\n        _store.load()\n    return _store\n\n\ndef reload_knowledge() -> int:\n    return get_knowledge_store().reload()\n"
}

{lim.get('monthly_max', '?')} 封\")\n        return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n\n    def get_title_formulas() -> str:\n        data = store.get(\"title_formulas\")\n        if not data:\n            return },\n            func=get_segment_strategy,\n        ),\n        Tool(\n            name=\"get_content_pattern\",\n \"churn_recall\",\n    \"dormant\": \"churn_recall\",\n    \"declining\": \"win_back_declining\",\n}\n\n\ndef build_analysis_tools(store: KnowledgeStore) -> list[Tool]:\n\n    def recommend_intent(\n        segment: str,\n        paid_ratio: float = 0.0,\n        dominant_lifecycle: str = \"\",\n        goal_hint: str = \"\",\n    ) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Recommend a marketing intent based on audience characteristics.\"\"\"\n        result: dict = {\n            \"segment\": segment,\n            \"paid_ratio\": paid_ratio,\n            \"dominant_lifecycle\": dominant_lifecycle,\n            \"goal_hint\": goal_hint,\n        }\n\n        decision_tree = store.get(\"decision_tree\")\n        goal_keywords = {}\n        if decision_tree:\n            for rule in decision_tree.get(\"rules\", []):\n                kw = rule.get(\"keywords\")\n                if kw:\n                    goal_keywords = kw\n                    break\n\n        if goal_hint:\n            hint_lower = goal_hint.lower()\n            for intent_id, keywords in goal_keywords.items():\n                if any(kw in hint_lower for kw in keywords):\n                    result[\"intent\"] = intent_id\n                    result[\"source\"] = \"goal_hint\"\n                    result[\"confidence\"] = \"high\"\n                    break\n\n        if \"intent\" not in result:\n            if dominant_lifecycle in INTENT_PRIORITY:\n                result[\"intent\"] = INTENT_PRIORITY[dominant_lifecycle]\n                result[\"source\"] = \"lifecycle\"\n                result[\"confidence\"] = \"high\"\n            elif dominant_lifecycle in (\"active\", \"power_user\"):\n                if segment == \"S\":\n                    result[\"intent\"] = \"retention\"\n                    result[\"source\"] = \"segment_S_rule\"\n                    result[\"confidence\"] = \"high\"\n                elif paid_ratio < 0.3:\n                    result[\"intent\"] = \"upsell\"\n                    result[\"source\"] = \"low_paid_ratio\"\n                    result[\"confidence\"] = \"medium\"\n                else:\n                    result[\"intent\"] = \"feature_announcement\"\n                    result[\"source\"] = \"default_active\"\n                    result[\"confidence\"] = \"medium\"\n            else:\n                result[\"intent\"] = \"feature_announcement\"\n                result[\"source\"] = \"fallback\"\n                result[\"confidence\"] = \"low\"\n\n        tone_data = store.get(\"tone_mapping\")\n        if tone_data and \"mapping\" in tone_data:\n            t = tone_data[\"mapping\"].get(result.get(\"intent\", \"\"), {})\n            result[\"recommended_tone\"] = t.get(\"primary\", \"专业友好\")\n            result[\"alternative_tone\"] = t.get(\"alternative\", \"\")\n\n        return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n\n    return [\n        Tool(\n            name=\"recommend_intent\",\n            description=\"根据受众分层、付费比例、生命周期阶段和运营目标提示，自动推荐最匹配的营销意图和语气\",\n            parameters={\n                \"type\": \"object\",\n                \"properties\": {\n                    \"segment\": {\n                        \"type\": \"string\",\n                        \"enum\": [\"S\", \"A\", \"B\", \"C\"],\n                        \"description\": \"用户分层\",\n                    },\n                    \"paid_ratio\": {\n                        \"type\": \"number\",\n                        \"description\": \"付费用户比例 (0-1)\",\n                    },\n                    \"dominant_lifecycle\": {\n                        \"type\": \"string\",\n                        \"description\": \"主要生命周期阶段: new_inactive/onboarding/active/power_user/declining/dormant/churned\",\n                    },\n                    \"goal_hint\": {\n                        \"type\": \"string\",\n                        \"description\": \"运营目标提示（可选）\",\n                    },\n                },\n                \"required\": [\"segment\"],\n            },\n            func=recommend_intent,\n        ),\n    ]\n"

 \"detected_intent\": \"营销意图 ID\",\n    \"chosen_tone\": \"AI 选择的语气\",\n    \"strategy_reasoning\": \"一句话说明为什么这样写（30字以内）\"\n  },\n  \"email_title\": \"邮件标题，15字以内\",\n  \"greeting\": \"称呼语\",\n  \"intro_line\": \"开场白，1-2句\",\n  \"body_paragraphs\": [\"正文段落1\", \"正文段落2\"],\n  \"highlight_title\": \"亮点区域标题\",\n  \"highlight_desc\": \"亮点区域描述\",\n  \"highlight_items\": [\"亮点1\", \"亮点2\", 综合以上信息，自主撰写邮件内容\n\n## 目标受众 — 分层 {segment}\n{profile_summary or '（请通过工具获取策略信息）'}\n{goal_part}\n\n## 输出格式\n完成所有工具调用后，输出以下 JSON 结构（不要添加其他字段，不要用 markdown 代码块包裹）:\n{AUTONOMOUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA}\n\n## 写作要求\n1. 语言: {lang_name} ({lang})\n2. 品牌名/产品名保持英文原样: {', '.join(PROTECTED_TERMS)}\n3. 按钮文案 (cta_text) 控制在 8 字以内\n4. body_paragraphs 2-3 段，每段 50-100 字\n5. highlight_items 3-5 条，每条 20 字以内\n6. email_title key)\n    return {\"ok\": True, \"key\": key}\n\n\n# ── Delete ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n@router.delete(\"/{category}/{name}\")\nasync def delete_skill(\n    category: str,\n    name: str,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n):\n    \"\"\"Delete a knowledge file.\"\"\"\n    _require_admin(user)\n    from app.agent.skills.loader import get_knowledge_store\n    store = get_knowledge_store()\n    key = name if category == \"_root\" else f\"{category}/{name}\"\n\n    if not store.delete_entry(key):\n        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, f\"知识条目 '{key}' 不存在\")\n\n    _reset_agent()\n    logger.info(\"Knowledge deleted by %s: %s\", user.email, key)\n    return {\"ok\": True, \"key\": key}\n\n\n# ── Reload ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n@router.post(\"/reload\")\nasync def reload_skills(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    \"\"\"Manually trigger a knowledge hot-reload.\"\"\"\n    _require_admin(user)\n    from app.agent.skills.loader import reload_knowledge\n    changed = reload_knowledge()\n    _reset_agent()\n    return {\"ok\": True, \"changed\": changed}\n\n\n# ── Test agent ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nclass AgentTestRequest(BaseModel):\n    material: str\n    segment: str = \"A\"\n    lang: str = \"zh-CN\"\n    goal_hint: str = \"\"\n    cta_url: str = \"\"\n\n\n@router.post(\"/test-agent\")\nasync def test_agent(\n    req: AgentTestRequest,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n):\n    \"\"\"Run the agent with current knowledge and return result + tool call log.\"\"\"\n    from app.agent.executor import AgentExecutor\n    from app.agent.prompts import build_agent_system_prompt, build_agent_user_prompt\n    from app.agent.tools.registry import build_all_tools\n    from app.ai_providers import get_content_provider\n\n    tools = build_all_tools()\n    provider = get_content_provider()\n    executor = AgentExecutor(\n        provider=provider, tools=tools,\n        max_iterations=settings.AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS,\n    )\n\n    system = build_agent_system_prompt(req.segment, req.lang, goal_hint=req.goal_hint)\n    user_prompt = build_agent_user_prompt(req.material, req.segment, req.lang, req.cta_url or None)\n\n    try:\n        result = await executor.run(system, user_prompt, temperature=0.7)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY, f\"Agent 执行失败: {exc}\")\n\n    return {\n        \"content\": result.content,\n        \"tool_calls_log\": result.tool_calls_log,\n        \"iterations\": result.iterations,\n    }\n\n\n# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfrom app.config import settings  # noqa: E402\n\n\ndef _reset_agent() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reset the cached agent so it picks up new tools/knowledge.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        from app.services.ai_service import ai_service\n        ai_service.reset_agent()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\features\\skills\\skillsApi.ts",
 "contents": "/**\n * Skills API client — CRUD for knowledge YAML files and agent testing.\n */\n\nconst BASE = '/api';\n\nfunction authHeaders(): Record<string, string> {\n  const token = localStorage.getItem('edm_token');\n  return {\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n    ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nexport interface SkillEntry {\n  key: string;\n  category: string;\n  name: string;\n  label: string;\n  description: string;\n}\n\nexport interface SkillDetail {\n  key: string;\n  category: string;\n  name: string;\n  raw_yaml: string;\n  data: Record<string, unknown>;\n}\n\nexport interface SkillListResponse {\n  categories: Record<string, SkillEntry[]>;\n  total: number;\n}\n\nexport interface AgentTestResult {\n  content: string;\n  tool_calls_log: Array<{\n    iteration: number;\n    tool: string;\n    arguments: Record<string, unknown>;\n    result_preview: string;\n  }>;\n  iterations: number;\n}\n\nexport async function apiListSkills(): Promise<SkillListResponse> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/skills`, { headers: authHeaders() });\n  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`获取技能列表失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  return resp.json();\n}\n\nexport async function apiGetSkill(category: string, name: string): Promise<SkillDetail> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/skills/${category}/${name}`, { headers: authHeaders() });\n  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`获取技能详情失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  return resp.json();\n}\n\nexport async function apiUpdateSkill(category: string, name: string, content: string): Promise<void> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/skills/${category}/${name}`, {\n    method: 'PUT',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n    body: JSON.stringify({ content }),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n    throw new Error(err.detail ?? `更新失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function apiCreateSkill(category: string, name: string, content: string): Promise<void> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/skills/${category}/${name}`, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n    body: JSON.stringify({ content }),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n    throw new Error(err.detail ?? `创建失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function apiDeleteSkill(category: string, name: string): Promise<void> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/skills/${category}/${name}`, {\n    method: 'DELETE',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n    throw new Error(err.detail ?? `删除失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function apiReloadSkills(): Promise<{ changed: number }> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/skills/reload`, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`重载失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  return resp.json();\n}\n\nexport async function apiTestAgent(params: {\n  material: string;\n  segment?: string;\n  lang?: string;\n  goal_hint?: string;\n  cta_url?: string;\n}): Promise<AgentTestResult> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/skills/test-agent`, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n    body: JSON.stringify(params),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n    throw new Error(err.detail ?? `Agent 测试失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  }\n  return resp.json();\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport {\n  Card,\n  Typography,\n  Spin,\n  Input,\n  Tag,\n  Space,\n  Button,\n  Row,\n  Col,\n  Empty,\n  message,\n  Popconfirm,\n} from 'antd';\nimport {\n  BookOutlined,\n  UserOutlined,\n  GlobalOutlined,\n  AimOutlined,\n  ReloadOutlined,\n  DeleteOutlined,\n  ThunderboltOutlined,\n} from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport { usePermission } from '@/hooks/usePermission';\nimport {\n  apiListSkills,\n  apiDeleteSkill,\n  apiReloadSkills,\n  type SkillEntry,\n  type SkillListResponse,\n} from '../skillsApi';\n\nconst { Title, Text, Paragraph } = Typography;\nconst { Search } = Input;\n\nconst CATEGORY_META: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = {\n  intents: { label: '营销意图', color: 'blue', icon: <AimOutlined /> },\n  segments: { label: '分层策略', color: 'green', icon: <UserOutlined /> },\n  localization: { label: '本地化指南', color: 'orange', icon: <GlobalOutlined /> },\n  _root: { label: '通用配置', color: 'purple', icon: <BookOutlined /> },\n};\n\nexport default function SkillListPage() {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { isAdmin } = usePermission();\n  const [data, setData] = useState<SkillListResponse | null>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');\n\n  const fetchData = async () => {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await apiListSkills();\n      setData(res);\n    } catch (err) {\n      message.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : '加载失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, []);\n\n  const handleReload = async () => {\n    try {\n      const res = await apiReloadSkills();\n      message.success(`知识库已重载，${res.changed} 个文件变更`);\n      fetchData();\n    } catch (err) {\n      message.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : '重载失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (entry: SkillEntry) => {\n    try {\n      await apiDeleteSkill(entry.category, entry.name);\n      message.success(`已删除 ${entry.label}`);\n      fetchData();\n    } catch (err) {\n      message.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : '删除失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const filteredCategories = data\n    ? Object.entries(data.categories).reduce<Record<string, SkillEntry[]>>(\n        (acc, [cat, entries]) => {\n          const filtered = entries.filter(\n            (e) =>\n              !search ||\n              e.label.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||\n              e.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||\n              e.description.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()),\n          );\n          if (filtered.length) acc[cat] = filtered;\n          return acc;\n        },\n        {},\n      )\n    : {};\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 80 }}>\n        <Spin size=\"large\" />\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 24 }}>\n        <div>\n          <Title level={3} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n            <ThunderboltOutlined style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />\n            Agent 知识库\n          </Title>\n          <Text type=\"secondary\">管理 AI Agent 的领域知识、营销策略和本地化指南</Text>\n        </div>\n        <Space>\n          <Search\n            placeholder=\"搜索知识...\"\n            allowClear\n            onSearch={(v) => setSearch(v)}\n            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n            style={{ width: 240 }}\n          />\n          {isAdmin && (\n            <>\n              <Button icon={<ReloadOutlined />} onClick={handleReload}>\n                重载知识库\n              </Button>\n              <Button\n                type=\"primary\"\n                onClick={() => navigate('/skills/test')}\n                icon={<ThunderboltOutlined />}\n              >\n                测试 Agent\n              </Button>\n            </>\n          )}\n        </Space>\n      </div>\n\n      {Object.keys(filteredCategories).length === 0 ? (\n        <Empty description=\"没有找到知识条目\" />\n      ) : (\n        Object.entries(filteredCategories).map(([cat, entries]) => {\n          const meta = CATEGORY_META[cat] || { label: cat, color: 'default', icon: <BookOutlined /> };\n          return (\n            <div key={cat} style={{ marginBottom: 32 }}>\n              <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>\n                <Space>\n                  {meta.icon}\n                  <Title level={5} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n                    {meta.label}\n                  </Title>\n                  <Tag color={meta.color}>{entries.length} 项</Tag>\n                </Space>\n              </div>\n              <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>\n                {entries.map((entry) => (\n                  <Col key={entry.key} xs={24} sm={12} md={8} lg={6}>\n                    <Card\n                      hoverable\n                      size=\"small\"\n                      onClick={() =>\n                        navigate(`/skills/${entry.category}/${entry.name}`)\n                      }\n                      actions={\n                        isAdmin\n                          ? [\n                              <Popconfirm\n                                key=\"del\"\n                                title=\"确定删除？\"\n                                onConfirm={(e) => {\n                                  e?.stopPropagation();\n                                  handleDelete(entry);\n                                }}\n                                onCancel={(e) => e?.stopPropagation()}\n                              >\n                                <DeleteOutlined\n                                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}\n                                />\n                              </Popconfirm>,\n                            ]\n                          : undefined\n                      }\n                    >\n                      <Card.Meta\n                        title={entry.label}\n                        description={\n                          <Paragraph\n                            type=\"secondary\"\n                            ellipsis={{ rows: 2 }}\n                            style={{ marginBottom: 0, fontSize: 12 }}\n                          >\n                            {entry.description || entry.name}\n                          </Paragraph>\n                        }\n                      />\n                    </Card>\n                  </Col>\n                ))}\n              </Row>\n            </div>\n          );\n        })\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\features\\skills\\pages\\SkillEditPage.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport {\n  Typography,\n  Button,\n  Space,\n  Spin,\n  message,\n  Card,\n  Alert,\n  Tag,\n  Breadcrumb,\n} from 'antd';\nimport { ArrowLeftOutlined, SaveOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport Editor from '@monaco-editor/react';\nimport { usePermission } from '@/hooks/usePermission';\nimport { apiGetSkill, apiUpdateSkill, type SkillDetail } from '../skillsApi';\n\nconst { Title, Text } = Typography;\n\nexport default function SkillEditPage() {\n  const { category = '', name = '' } = useParams<{ category: string; name: string }>();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { isAdmin } = usePermission();\n\n  const [skill, setSkill] = useState<SkillDetail | null>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);\n  const [editedYaml, setEditedYaml] = useState('');\n  const [hasChanges, setHasChanges] = useState(false);\n  const [yamlError, setYamlError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n\n  const fetchSkill = useCallback(async () => {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await apiGetSkill(category, name);\n      setSkill(res);\n      setEditedYaml(res.raw_yaml);\n      setHasChanges(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      message.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : '加载失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [category, name]);\n\n  useEffect(() => { fetchSkill(); }, [fetchSkill]);\n\n  const handleEditorChange = (value: string | undefined) => {\n    const v = value ?? '';\n    setEditedYaml(v);\n    setHasChanges(v !== skill?.raw_yaml);\n    setYamlError(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = async () => {\n    if (!isAdmin) return;\n    setSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await apiUpdateSkill(category, name, editedYaml);\n      message.success('保存成功，知识已生效');\n      setHasChanges(false);\n      if (skill) {\n        setSkill({ ...skill, raw_yaml: editedYaml });\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : '保存失败';\n      if (msg.includes('YAML')) {\n        setYamlError(msg);\n      } else {\n        message.error(msg);\n      }\n    } finally {\n      setSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 80 }}>\n        <Spin size=\"large\" />\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (!skill) {\n    return (\n      <Alert type=\"error\" message=\"未找到该知识条目\" showIcon />\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Breadcrumb\n        style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n        items={[\n          { title: <a onClick={() => navigate('/skills')}>知识库</a> },\n          { title: category },\n          { title: name },\n        ]}\n      />\n\n      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Space>\n          <Button icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />} onClick={() => navigate('/skills')}>\n            返回列表\n          </Button>\n          <Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n            {skill.data && typeof skill.data === 'object'\n              ? (skill.data as Record<string, unknown>).label as string\n                ?? (skill.data as Record<string, unknown>).name as string\n                ?? name\n              : name}\n          </Title>\n          <Tag>{skill.key}</Tag>\n        </Space>\n        <Space>\n          {hasChanges && <Tag color=\"orange\">未保存</Tag>}\n          {isAdmin && (\n            <Button\n              type=\"primary\"\n              icon={<SaveOutlined />}\n              loading={saving}\n              disabled={!hasChanges}\n              onClick={handleSave}\n            >\n              保存\n            </Button>\n          )}\n        </Space>\n      </div>\n\n      {yamlError && (\n        <Alert\n          type=\"error\"\n          message=\"YAML 格式错误\"\n          description={yamlError}\n          closable\n          onClose={() => setYamlError(null)}\n          style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      <Card styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }}>\n        <Editor\n          height=\"65vh\"\n          language=\"yaml\"\n          value={editedYaml}\n          onChange={handleEditorChange}\n          options={{\n            minimap: { enabled: false },\n            fontSize: 14,\n            lineNumbers: 'on',\n            wordWrap: 'on',\n            scrollBeyondLastLine: false,\n            readOnly: !isAdmin,\n            tabSize: 2,\n          }}\n        />\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

Tag,\n  Spin,\n  message,\n  Breadcrumb,\n  Timeline,\n  Descriptions,\n} from 'antd';\nimport {\n  ArrowLeftOutlined,\n  ThunderboltOutlined,\n  ToolOutlined,\n} from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport = [\n  { value: 'S', label: 'S — 高价值付费活跃' },\n  { value: 'A', label: 'A — 活跃混合' },\n  { value: 'B', label: 'B — 免费低活跃' },\n  { value: 'C', label: 'C — 流失风险' },\n];\n\nconst LANGS = [\n  { value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },\n  { value: 'en', label: 'English' },\n  { value: 'ja', label: '日本語' },\n  { value: 'ko', label: '한국어' },\n  { value: 'zh-TW', label: '繁體中文' },\n  { value: 'fr', label: 'Français' },\n  { value: 'de', label: 'Deutsch' },\n  { value: 'es', label: 'Español' },\n];\n\nexport default function SkillTestPage() {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [loading, instanceof Error) {\n        message.error(err.message);\n      }\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Breadcrumb\n        style={{ marginBottom: 16       </Button>\n          <Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n            <ThunderboltOutlined style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />\n            Agent 测试\n          </Title>\n        </Space>\n  "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\app\\agent\\tools\\registry.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"Tool registry — maps tool names to callables and OpenAI function schemas.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Any, Callable\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nToolFunction = Callable[..., str]\n\n\nclass ToolRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Central registry that stores tool functions alongside their OpenAI\n    ``tools`` schema definitions.  The :class:`AgentExecutor` queries this\n    registry to build the ``tools`` payload and to dispatch calls.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._functions: dict[str, ToolFunction] = {}\n        self._schemas: dict[str, dict] = {}\n\n    def register(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        func: ToolFunction,\n        description: str,\n        parameters: dict | None = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self._functions[name] = func\n        self._schemas[name] = {\n            \"type\": \"function\",\n            \"function\": {\n                \"name\": name,\n                \"description\": description,\n                \"parameters\": parameters or {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {}},\n            },\n        }\n\n    def get_tools_payload(self) -> list[dict]:\n        \"\"\"Return the list of tool schemas in OpenAI ``tools`` format.\"\"\"\n        return list(self._schemas.values())\n\n    def call(self, name: str, arguments: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Execute a registered tool by name with a JSON arguments string.\"\"\"\n        func = self._functions.get(name)\n        if func is None:\n            return json.dumps({\"error\": f\"Unknown tool: {name}\"}, ensure_ascii=False)\n        try:\n            kwargs: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(arguments) if arguments.strip() else {}\n            result = func(**kwargs)\n            return result if isinstance(result, str) else json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False)\n        except Exception as exc:\n            logger.warning(\"Tool %s execution failed: %s\", name, exc)\n            return json.dumps({\"error\": str(exc)}, ensure_ascii=False)\n\n    @property\n    def tool_names(self) -> list[str]:\n        return list(self._functions.keys())\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\app\\agent\\executor.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"AgentExecutor — tool-calling loop that lets the AI autonomously fetch\nknowledge and produce a final text/JSON response.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom app.agent.models import AgentResult, ChatResponse\nfrom app.agent.tools.registry import ToolRegistry\nfrom app.ai_providers.base import OpenAICompatibleProvider\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nDEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS = 5\n\n\nclass AgentExecutor:\n    \"\"\"Runs a multi-turn tool-calling loop against an OpenAI-compatible\n    provider.\n\n    Flow:\n      1. Send system + user messages together with tool definitions.\n      2. If the model returns ``tool_calls`` → execute each tool via the\n         registry and append the results, then loop back to step 1.\n      3. If the model returns plain text (no tool calls) → treat as the\n         final answer and return.\n      4. Bail out after *max_iterations* rounds to prevent runaway loops.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        provider: OpenAICompatibleProvider,\n        registry: ToolRegistry,\n        *,\n        max_iterations: int = DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS,\n        temperature: float = 0.7,\n        max_tokens: int = 4096,\n    ):\n        self.provider = provider\n        self.registry = registry\n        self.max_iterations = max_iterations\n        self.temperature = temperature\n        self.max_tokens = max_tokens\n\n    async def run(\n        self,\n        system_prompt: str,\n        user_prompt: str,\n    ) -> AgentResult:\n        messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": system_prompt},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_prompt},\n        ]\n        tools_payload = self.registry.get_tools_payload()\n        tool_call_log: list[dict] = []\n\n        for iteration in range(1, self.max_iterations + 1):\n            logger.info(\"Agent iteration %d/%d\", iteration, self.max_iterations)\n\n            response: ChatResponse = await self.provider.chat_completion_with_tools(\n                messages,\n                tools=tools_payload,\n                temperature=self.temperature,\n                max_tokens=self.max_tokens,\n            )\n\n            if not response.has_tool_calls:\n                logger.info(\"Agent finished after %d iteration(s)\", iteration)\n                return AgentResult(\n                    content=response.content or \"\",\n                    tool_call_log=tool_call_log,\n                    iterations=iteration,\n                )\n\n            assistant_msg: dict[str, Any] = {\"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": response.content}\n            assistant_msg[\"tool_calls\"] = [\n                {\n                    \"id\": tc.id,\n                    \"type\": \"function\",\n                    \"function\": {\"name\": tc.name, \"arguments\": tc.arguments},\n                }\n                for tc in response.tool_calls\n            ]\n            messages.append(assistant_msg)\n\n            for tc in response.tool_calls:\n                logger.info(\"  → tool: %s(%s)\", tc.name, tc.arguments[:120])\n                result_str = self.registry.call(tc.name, tc.arguments)\n                logger.debug(\"  ← result: %.200s\", result_str)\n\n                tool_call_log.append({\n                    \"tool\": tc.name,\n                    \"arguments\": tc.arguments,\n                    \"result_preview\": result_str[:200],\n                })\n\n                messages.append({\n                    \"role\": \"tool\",\n                    \"tool_call_id\": tc.id,\n                    \"content\": result_str,\n                })\n\n        logger.warning(\"Agent hit max iterations (%d), returning last content\", self.max_iterations)\n        final_content = response.content or \"\"  # type: ignore[possibly-undefined]\n        return AgentResult(\n            content=final_content,\n            tool_call_log=tool_call_log,\n            iterations=self.max_iterations,\n        )\n"
}
