 "contents": "\"\"\"Streamlined system prompts for the Agent-based content generation.\n\nThe old approach injected ~200 lines of domain knowledge directly into the\nsystem prompt.  Now the system prompt only describes the AI's *role* and\n*available tools*; knowledge is fetched on-demand via function calling.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.schemas.ai import SegmentProfile\n\nPROTECTED_TERMS = [\n    \"TapNow\", \"Pro\", \"Premium\", \"Basic\", \"Free\", \"Enterprise\",\n]\n\nLANG_NAMES: dict[str, str] = {\n    \"zh-CN\": \"简体中文\", \"zh-TW\": \"繁體中文\", \"en\": \"English\",\n    \"ja\": \"日本語\", \"ko\": \"한국어\", \"fr\": \"Français\", \"de\": \"Deutsch\",\n    \"es\": \"Español\", \"it\": \"Italiano\", \"pt\": \"Português\", \"ru\": \"Русский\",\n    \"ar\": \"العربية\", \"th\": \"ไทย\", \"vi\": \"Tiếng Việt\",\n    \"id\": \"Bahasa Indonesia\", \"ms\": \"Bahasa Melayu\",\n}\n\nAUTONOMOUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\\\n{\n  \"ai_decisions\": {\n    \"detected_intent\": \"营销意图 (new_user_onboarding / churn_recall / upsell / feature_announcement / retention / win_back_declining)\",\n    \"chosen_tone\": \"语气 (专业友好 / 轻松活泼 / 紧迫促销 / 温情关怀 / 正式商务 / 轻松引导)\",\n    \"strategy_reasoning\": \"一句话决策理由（30字以内）\"\n  },\n  \"email_title\": \"邮件标题，15字以内\",\n  \"greeting\": \"称呼语\",\n  \"intro_line\": \"开场白，1-2句\",\n  \"body_paragraphs\": [\"正文段落1\", \"正文段落2\"],\n  \"highlight_title\": \"亮点区域标题\",\n  \"highlight_desc\": \"亮点区域描述\",\n  \"highlight_items\": [\"亮点1\", \"亮点2\", \"亮点3\"],\n  \"highlight_note\": \"补充说明\",\n  \"cta_text\": \"按钮文案，8字以内\",\n  \"closing_text\": \"结尾语\",\n  \"team_name\": \"TapNow Team\",\n  \"send_date\": \"\"\n}\"\"\"\n\n\ndef build_agent_system_prompt(\n    segment: str,\n    profile: SegmentProfile | None,\n    lang: str,\n    goal_hint: str = \"\",\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Build a concise system prompt that defines the Agent role and output\n    format.  Domain knowledge is *not* injected — the model is expected to\n    call tools to retrieve it.\"\"\"\n\n    if profile is None:\n        profile = SegmentProfile(character_summary=f\"分层 {segment} 用户\")\n\n    lang_name = LANG_NAMES.get(lang, lang)\n    plans_str = \", \".join(profile.top_plans) if profile.top_plans else \"N/A\"\n    goal_part = f\"\\n运营人员补充的营销目标提示: {goal_hint}\" if goal_hint else \"\"\n\n    return f\"\"\"\\\n你是一个拥有完全决策权的邮件营销 AI Agent，服务于 TapNow 平台。\n\n## 工作流程\n1. 调用 get_decision_tree 获取意图决策树\n2. 调用 get_segment_strategy 获取分层 {segment} 的策略\n3. 根据决策树匹配意图后，调用 get_intent_info 获取意图详情\n4. 调用 get_content_pattern 获取该意图的内容写作模式\n5. 如果目标语言不是中文，调用 get_localization_guide 获取本地化指南\n6. 调用 get_title_formulas 获取标题写作公式\n7. 综合以上知识，撰写邮件内容\n\n## 目标受众 — 分层 {segment}\n{profile.character_summary or '（未提供画像）'}\n- 人数: {profile.count}\n- 付费比例: {profile.paid_ratio:.0%}\n- 主要订阅计划: {plans_str}\n{goal_part}\n\n## 输出格式\n完成所有工具调用后，严格输出以下 JSON（不要用 markdown 代码块包裹）:\n{AUTONOMOUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA}\n\n## 写作要求\n1. 语言: {lang_name} ({lang})\n2. 品牌名/产品名保持英文: {', '.join(PROTECTED_TERMS)}\n3. cta_text 控制在 8 字以内\n4. body_paragraphs 2-3 段，每段 50-100 字\n5. highlight_items 3-5 条，每条 20 字以内\n6. email_title 15 字以内\"\"\"\n\n\ndef build_agent_user_prompt(\n    material: str,\n    segment: str,\n    lang: str,\n    cta_url: str | None = None,\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Build the user message that provides campaign material to the Agent.\"\"\"\n    lang_name = LANG_NAMES.get(lang, lang)\n    cta_part = f\"\\nCTA 链接: {cta_url}\" if cta_url else \"\"\n\n    return f\"\"\"\\\n请为分层 {segment} 的 {lang_name} 用户生成邮件内容。\n先使用工具获取所需知识，再撰写内容。\n\n## 活动素材\n{material}\n{cta_part}\n\n直接输出 JSON，不要包含任何解释或 markdown 标记。\"\"\"\n\n\ndef build_strategy_system_prompt() -> str:\n    \"\"\"System prompt for lightweight strategy-only generation.\"\"\"\n    return \"\"\"\\\n你是一个拥有完全决策权的邮件营销策略 AI Agent。\n请先调用 get_decision_tree 和 get_segment_strategy 获取知识，再制定策略。\n\n输出纯文本，1-2 句话，50 字以内。不要输出 JSON 或 markdown。\n策略应说明：针对什么类型的用户 + 核心营销手法 + 预期效果。\"\"\"\n\n\ndef build_strategy_user_prompt(\n    segment: str,\n    profile: SegmentProfile,\n    material: str,\n    goal_hint: str = \"\",\n) -> str:\n    plans_str = \", \".join(profile.top_plans) if profile.top_plans else \"N/A\"\n    material_summary = material[:300] + (\"...\" if len(material) > 300 else \"\")\n    hint_part = f\"\\n运营目标提示: {goal_hint}\" if goal_hint else \"\"\n\n    return f\"\"\"\\\n## 分层 {segment} 画像\n- 特征: {profile.character_summary or '未知'}\n- 人数: {profile.count}\n- 付费比例: {profile.paid_ratio:.0%}\n- 主要订阅: {plans_str}{hint_part}\n\n## 活动素材概要\n{material_summary}\n\n请使用工具获取决策树和分层策略后，制定内容策略:\"\"\"\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\app\\agent\\tools\\registry.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"Tool registry — maps tool names to callables and OpenAI function schemas.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Any, Callable\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nToolFunction = Callable[..., str]\n\n\nclass ToolRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Central registry that stores tool functions alongside their OpenAI\n    ``tools`` schema definitions.  The AgentExecutor queries this registry\n    to build the ``tools`` payload and to dispatch calls.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._functions: dict[str, ToolFunction] = {}\n        self._schemas: dict[str, dict] = {}\n\n    def register(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        func: ToolFunction,\n        description: str,\n        parameters: dict | None = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self._functions[name] = func\n        self._schemas[name] = {\n            \"type\": \"function\",\n            \"function\": {\n                \"name\": name,\n                \"description\": description,\n                \"parameters\": parameters or {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {}},\n            },\n        }\n\n    def get_tools_payload(self) -> list[dict]:\n        \"\"\"Return the list of tool schemas in OpenAI ``tools`` format.\"\"\"\n        return list(self._schemas.values())\n\n    def call(self, name: str, arguments: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Execute a registered tool by name with a JSON arguments string.\"\"\"\n        func = self._functions.get(name)\n        if func is None:\n            return json.dumps({\"error\": f\"Unknown tool: {name}\"}, ensure_ascii=False)\n        try:\n            kwargs: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(arguments) if arguments.strip() else {}\n            result = func(**kwargs)\n            return result if isinstance(result, str) else json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False)\n        except Exception as exc:\n            logger.warning(\"Tool %s execution failed: %s\", name, exc)\n            return json.dumps({\"error\": str(exc)}, ensure_ascii=False)\n\n    @property\n    def tool_names(self) -> list[str]:\n        return list(self._functions.keys())\n"
}

 "new_string": "\"\"\"Data models for Agent framework — ChatResponse with tool_calls support.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\n\nclass ToolCall(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"A single tool invocation returned by the AI model.\"\"\"\n\n    id: str\n    function_name: str\n    arguments: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)\n\n\nclass ChatResponse(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Structured response from chat_completion_with_tools.\n\n    Either ``content`` (final text answer) or ``tool_calls`` (tool invocations)\n    will be populated — not both in normal usage.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    content: str | None = None\n    tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = Field(default_factory=list)\n\n    @property\n    def has_tool_calls(self) -> bool:\n        return len(self.tool_calls) > 0\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_openai(cls, choice: dict[str, Any]) -> ChatResponse:\n        \"\"\"Parse a single ``choices[i]`` dict from an OpenAI-compatible API.\"\"\"\n        msg = choice.get(\"message\", {})\n        content = msg.get(\"content\")\n        raw_calls = msg.get(\"tool_calls\") or []\n        calls: list[ToolCall] = []\n        for tc in raw_calls:\n            fn = tc.get(\"function\", {})\n            raw_args = fn.get(\"arguments\", \"{}\")\n            try:\n                args = json.loads(raw_args) if isinstance(raw_args, str) else raw_args\n            except json.JSONDecodeError:\n                args = {\"_raw\": raw_args}\n            calls.append(ToolCall(\n                id=tc.get(\"id\", \"\"),\n                function_name=fn.get(\"name\", \"\"),\n                arguments=args,\n            ))\n        return cls(content=content, tool_calls=calls)"
}

 "contents": "\"\"\"Tool registry — central catalog of all Agent tools with OpenAI function schemas.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Awaitable\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nToolFunction = Callable[..., str | Awaitable[str]]\n\n\nclass ToolDef:\n    \"\"\"A registered tool: its callable + OpenAI function-calling schema.\"\"\"\n\n    __slots__ = (\"name\", \"fn\", \"schema\")\n\n    def __init__(self, name: str, fn: ToolFunction, schema: dict[str, Any]):\n        self.name = name\n        self.fn = fn\n        self.schema = schema\n\n\nclass ToolRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Holds all tool definitions and provides lookup + schema export.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._tools: dict[str, ToolDef] = {}\n\n    def register(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        description: str,\n        parameters: dict[str, Any],\n        fn: ToolFunction,\n    ) -> None:\n        schema = {\n            \"type\": \"function\",\n            \"function\": {\n                \"name\": name,\n                \"description\": description,\n                \"parameters\": parameters,\n            },\n        }\n        self._tools[name] = ToolDef(name=name, fn=fn, schema=schema)\n        logger.debug(\"Registered tool: %s\", name)\n\n    def get(self, name: str) -> ToolDef | None:\n        return self._tools.get(name)\n\n    def get_openai_schemas(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Return all tool schemas in OpenAI function-calling format.\"\"\"\n        return [t.schema for t in self._tools.values()]\n\n    @property\n    def tool_names(self) -> list[str]:\n        return list(self._tools.keys())\n\n    def __len__(self) -> int:\n        return len(self._tools)\n\n\ntool_registry = ToolRegistry()\n"
}

will be rewired to read from YAML files via the knowledge loader.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\n\nfrom app.agent.tools.registry import tool_registry\nfrom app.services.prompt_knowledge import (\n    CONTENT_PATTERNS,\n    DECISION_TREE,\n    INTENT_DEFINITIONS,\n    INTENT_TONE_MAP,\n    LOCALIZATION_GUIDES,\n    SEGMENT_FREQ_LIMITS,\n    SEGMENT_STRATEGIES,\n    TIMING_WINDOWS,\n    TITLE_FORMULAS,\n)\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. get_decision_tree\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef get_decision_tree() -> str:\n    return DECISION_TREE\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_decision_tree\",\n    description=\"获取营销意图决策树，描述如何根据用户分层和行为特征匹配意图（new_user_onboarding / churn_recall / upsell / feature_announcement / retention / win_back_declining）。每次内容生成前应先调用此工具确定意图。\",\n    parameters={\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {}, \"required\": []},\n    fn=get_decision_tree,\n)\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. get_intent_info\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef get_intent_info(intent: str) -> str:\n    info = INTENT_DEFINITIONS.get(intent)\n    if not info:\n        available = \", \".join(INTENT_DEFINITIONS.keys())\n        return f\"未知意图: {intent}。可选: {available}\"\n    tone_primary, tone_alt = INTENT_TONE_MAP.get(intent, (\"专业友好\", \"\"))\n    return json.dumps({\n        **info,\n        \"recommended_tone\": tone_primary,\n        \"alternative_tone\": tone_alt,\n    }, ensure_ascii=False)\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_intent_info\",\n    description=\"获取指定营销意图的详细信息，包括名称、目的、适用受众和推荐语气。\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"intent\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"意图标识符\",\n                \"enum\": list(INTENT_DEFINITIONS.keys()),\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"intent\"],\n    },\n    fn=get_intent_info,\n)\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. get_segment_strategy\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef get_segment_strategy(segment: str) -> str:\n    s = SEGMENT_STRATEGIES.get(segment)\n    if not s:\n        return f\"未知分层: {segment}。可选: S, A, B, C\"\n    freq = SEGMENT_FREQ_LIMITS.get(segment, \"\")\n    result = {**s, \"frequency\": freq}\n    return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False)\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_segment_strategy\",\n    description=\"获取指定用户分层（S/A/B/C）的完整策略，包括核心目标、推荐语气、CTA方向、避坑清单、成功模式和发送频率限制。\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"segment\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"用户分层\",\n                \"enum\": [\"S\", \"A\", \"B\", \"C\"],\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"segment\"],\n    },\n    fn=get_segment_strategy,\n)\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. get_content_pattern\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef get_content_pattern(intent: str) -> str:\n    pattern = CONTENT_PATTERNS.get(intent)\n    if not pattern:\n        available = \", \".join(CONTENT_PATTERNS.keys())\n        return f\"未知意图: {intent}。可选: {available}\"\n    name = INTENT_DEFINITIONS.get(intent, {}).get(\"name\", intent)\n    return f\"## 内容模式 — {name}\\n{pattern}\"\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_content_pattern\",\n    description=\"获取指定营销意图的邮件内容写作模式，包括各字段（greeting、intro_line、body、highlight、cta等）的具体写法指导和标题公式。\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"intent\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"意图标识符\",\n                \"enum\": list(CONTENT_PATTERNS.keys()),\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"intent\"],\n    },\n    fn=get_content_pattern,\n)\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 5. get_localization_guide\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef get_localization_guide(lang: str) -> str:\n    guide = LOCALIZATION_GUIDES.get(lang)\n    if not guide:\n        if lang in (\"zh-CN\", \"en\"):\n            return f\"{lang} 无需特殊本地化指南。\"\n        available = \", \".join(LOCALIZATION_GUIDES.keys())\n        return f\"暂无 {lang} 本地化指南。已有: {available}\"\n    return guide\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_localization_guide\",\n    description=\"获取指定语言的营销本地化指南，包括称谓规范、营销偏好、CTA翻译参考和文化禁忌。\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"lang\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"语言代码，如 ja, ko, fr, de, es, zh-TW, ar 等\",\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"lang\"],\n    },\n    fn=get_localization_guide,\n)\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 6. get_timing_recommendation\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef get_timing_recommendation(intent: str) -> str:\n    timing = TIMING_WINDOWS.get(intent)\n    if not timing:\n        available = \", \".join(TIMING_WINDOWS.keys())\n        return f\"未知意图: {intent}。可选: {available}\"\n    return json.dumps(timing, ensure_ascii=False)\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_timing_recommendation\",\n    description=\"获取指定营销意图的最佳发送时机建议（最佳日期、最佳时段、原因）。\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"intent\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"意图标识符\",\n                \"enum\": list(TIMING_WINDOWS.keys()),\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"intent\"],\n    },\n    fn=get_timing_recommendation,\n)\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 7. get_title_formulas\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef get_title_formulas() -> str:\n    return TITLE_FORMULAS\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_title_formulas\",\n    description=\"获取邮件标题写作公式和质量要求（六种标题模式：好奇心驱动、利益驱动、紧迫感、情感连接、成就认可、问题导向）。\",\n    parameters={\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {}, \"required\": []},\n    fn=get_title_formulas,\n)\n"
}

 "contents": "\"\"\"Audience analysis tools — help the Agent reason about user segments.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\n\nfrom app.agent.tools.registry import tool_registry\nfrom app.services.prompt_knowledge import (\n    GOAL_HINT_KEYWORDS,\n    INTENT_DEFINITIONS,\n    INTENT_TONE_MAP,\n    SEGMENT_STRATEGIES,\n)\n\n\ndef recommend_intent(\n    segment: str,\n    paid_ratio: float = 0.0,\n    goal_hint: str = \"\",\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Analyze segment characteristics and recommend a marketing intent.\n\n    This encodes the same logic as the DECISION_TREE but as executable code,\n    giving the Agent a concrete recommendation it can accept or override.\n    \"\"\"\n    # 1. goal_hint keyword matching takes priority\n    if goal_hint:\n        hint_lower = goal_hint.lower()\n        for intent, keywords in GOAL_HINT_KEYWORDS.items():\n            if any(kw in hint_lower for kw in keywords):\n                tone = INTENT_TONE_MAP.get(intent, (\"专业友好\", \"\"))[0]\n                return json.dumps({\n                    \"recommended_intent\": intent,\n                    \"intent_name\": INTENT_DEFINITIONS[intent][\"name\"],\n                    \"tone\": tone,\n                    \"reason\": f\"goal_hint 包含关键词，匹配意图 {intent}\",\n                }, ensure_ascii=False)\n\n    # 2. Segment-based heuristics\n    seg_info = SEGMENT_STRATEGIES.get(segment, {})\n\n    if segment == \"C\":\n        intent = \"churn_recall\"\n        reason = \"C 层为流失风险用户，优先召回\"\n    elif segment == \"S\":\n        intent = \"retention\"\n        reason = \"S 层高价值用户，优先留存维护（不做 upsell）\"\n    elif segment == \"B\":\n        if paid_ratio < 0.2:\n            intent = \"win_back_declining\"\n            reason = \"B 层活跃度偏低且付费比例低，优先激活\"\n        else:\n            intent = \"feature_announcement\"\n            reason = \"B 层需建立产品价值认知\"\n    elif segment == \"A\":\n        if paid_ratio < 0.3:\n            intent = \"upsell\"\n            reason = \"A 层活跃但付费比例低，适合引导升级\"\n        else:\n            intent = \"feature_announcement\"\n            reason = \"A 层活跃且付费比例较高，推介新功能深化使用\"\n    else:\n        intent = \"feature_announcement\"\n        reason = f\"未知分层 {segment}，默认功能推广\"\n\n    tone = INTENT_TONE_MAP.get(intent, (\"专业友好\", \"\"))[0]\n    return json.dumps({\n        \"recommended_intent\": intent,\n        \"intent_name\": INTENT_DEFINITIONS.get(intent, {}).get(\"name\", intent),\n        \"tone\": tone,\n        \"segment_label\": seg_info.get(\"label\", \"\"),\n        \"reason\": reason,\n    }, ensure_ascii=False)\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"recommend_intent\",\n    description=\"根据用户分层（S/A/B/C）、付费比例和运营目标提示，分析受众特征并推荐最合适的营销意图。返回推荐意图、语气和推理原因。\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"segment\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"用户分层\",\n                \"enum\": [\"S\", \"A\", \"B\", \"C\"],\n            },\n            \"paid_ratio\": {\n                \"type\": \"number\",\n                \"description\": \"付费用户比例 (0.0-1.0)\",\n            },\n            \"goal_hint\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"运营人员补充的营销目标提示（可选）\",\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"segment\"],\n    },\n    fn=recommend_intent,\n)\n"
}

 "contents": "\"\"\"Content evaluation tools — help the Agent self-assess generated content.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\n\nfrom app.agent.tools.registry import tool_registry\nfrom app.services.prompt_knowledge import SEGMENT_STRATEGIES\n\n\ndef score_content(\n    segment: str,\n    intent: str,\n    email_title: str = \"\",\n    cta_text: str = \"\",\n    body_paragraph_count: int = 0,\n    highlight_item_count: int = 0,\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Score draft content against segment strategy rules and formatting requirements.\"\"\"\n    issues: list[str] = []\n    score = 100\n\n    seg = SEGMENT_STRATEGIES.get(segment, {})\n    avoid = seg.get(\"avoid\", \"\")\n\n    if len(email_title) > 15:\n        issues.append(f\"标题过长 ({len(email_title)} 字，要求 ≤15)\")\n        score -= 15\n\n    if not email_title:\n        issues.append(\"缺少标题\")\n        score -= 30\n\n    if len(cta_text) > 8:\n        issues.append(f\"CTA 文案过长 ({len(cta_text)} 字，要求 ≤8)\")\n        score -= 10\n\n    if body_paragraph_count < 2:\n        issues.append(f\"正文段落不足 ({body_paragraph_count}，建议 2-3 段)\")\n        score -= 10\n    elif body_paragraph_count > 4:\n        issues.append(f\"正文段落过多 ({body_paragraph_count}，建议 2-3 段)\")\n        score -= 5\n\n    if highlight_item_count < 2:\n        issues.append(f\"亮点条目不足 ({highlight_item_count}，建议 3-5 条)\")\n        score -= 10\n\n    if segment == \"S\" and intent == \"upsell\":\n        issues.append(\"S 层高价值用户不应做 upsell，会损害用户体验\")\n        score -= 25\n\n    if segment == \"C\" and intent == \"upsell\":\n        issues.append(\"C 层流失用户不应推销付费，应先召回\")\n        score -= 25\n\n    if segment == \"B\" and intent == \"upsell\":\n        issues.append(\"B 层用户未感受到产品价值，不宜推销付费\")\n        score -= 20\n\n    if \"折扣\" in avoid and segment == \"S\" and \"折\" in (email_title + cta_text):\n        issues.append(\"S 层策略禁止使用折扣券（暗示产品不值原价）\")\n        score -= 15\n\n    return json.dumps({\n        \"score\": max(0, score),\n        \"issues\": issues,\n        \"pass\": score >= 70,\n        \"suggestion\": \"内容质量良好\" if score >= 70 else \"建议根据上述问题调整内容\",\n    }, ensure_ascii=False)\n\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"score_content\",\n    description=\"评估邮件内容草稿的质量，检查标题长度、CTA文案、段落数量、意图-分层匹配等规则。返回分数（0-100）和具体问题列表。可在最终输出前调用，用于自我检查。\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"segment\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"用户分层\",\n                \"enum\": [\"S\", \"A\", \"B\", \"C\"],\n            },\n            \"intent\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"营销意图\",\n            },\n            \"email_title\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"邮件标题草稿\",\n            },\n            \"cta_text\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"按钮文案草稿\",\n            },\n            \"body_paragraph_count\": {\n                \"type\": \"integer\",\n                \"description\": \"正文段落数量\",\n            },\n            \"highlight_item_count\": {\n                \"type\": \"integer\",\n                \"description\": \"亮点条目数量\",\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"segment\", \"intent\"],\n    },\n    fn=score_content,\n)\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\app\\agent\\executor.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"AgentExecutor — the tool-calling loop that drives the AI Agent.\n\nFlow:\n  1. Send system + user messages with tool definitions to the AI provider\n  2. If the AI responds with tool_calls → execute each tool → append results → loop\n  3. If the AI responds with plain text → treat as final answer → return\n  4. Repeat up to ``max_iterations`` rounds to prevent infinite loops\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport inspect\nimport json\nimport logging\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n\nfrom app.agent.models import ChatResponse, ToolCall\nfrom app.agent.tools.registry import ToolRegistry, tool_registry\nfrom app.ai_providers.base import AIProvider\nfrom app.config import settings\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass AgentResult:\n    \"\"\"Final output of an agent execution run.\"\"\"\n\n    content: str\n    tool_calls_log: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)\n    iterations: int = 0\n    total_tokens_estimate: int = 0\n\n\nclass AgentExecutor:\n    \"\"\"Orchestrates the tool-calling loop between AI and registered tools.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        provider: AIProvider,\n        registry: ToolRegistry | None = None,\n        *,\n        max_iterations: int | None = None,\n        temperature: float = 0.7,\n        max_tokens: int = 4096,\n    ):\n        self.provider = provider\n        self.registry = registry or tool_registry\n        self.max_iterations = max_iterations or settings.AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS\n        self.temperature = temperature\n        self.max_tokens = max_tokens\n\n    async def run(\n        self,\n        system_prompt: str,\n        user_prompt: str,\n    ) -> AgentResult:\n        messages: list[dict] = [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": system_prompt},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_prompt},\n        ]\n        tools_schema = self.registry.get_openai_schemas()\n        tool_calls_log: list[dict] = []\n\n        t0 = time.monotonic()\n\n        for iteration in range(1, self.max_iterations + 1):\n            logger.info(\n                \"Agent iteration %d/%d — sending %d messages, %d tools\",\n                iteration, self.max_iterations, len(messages), len(tools_schema),\n            )\n\n            response: ChatResponse = await self.provider.chat_completion_with_tools(\n                messages,\n                tools=tools_schema if iteration < self.max_iterations else None,\n                tool_choice=\"auto\",\n                temperature=self.temperature,\n                max_tokens=self.max_tokens,\n            )\n\n            if not response.has_tool_calls:\n                elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0\n                logger.info(\n                    \"Agent completed in %d iterations (%.1fs) — final answer length: %d\",\n                    iteration, elapsed, len(response.content or \"\"),\n                )\n                return AgentResult(\n                    content=response.content or \"\",\n                    tool_calls_log=tool_calls_log,\n                    iterations=iteration,\n                )\n\n            # Execute tool calls and collect results\n            messages.append(self._build_assistant_tool_message(response))\n\n            tool_results = await self._execute_tool_calls(response.tool_calls)\n            for tc, result in zip(response.tool_calls, tool_results):\n                tool_calls_log.append({\n                    \"iteration\": iteration,\n                    \"tool\": tc.function_name,\n                    \"arguments\": tc.arguments,\n                    \"result_preview\": result[:200],\n                })\n                messages.append({\n                    \"role\": \"tool\",\n                    \"tool_call_id\": tc.id,\n                    \"content\": result,\n                })\n\n            logger.info(\n                \"Agent iteration %d — executed %d tools: %s\",\n                iteration,\n                len(response.tool_calls),\n                \", \".join(tc.function_name for tc in response.tool_calls),\n            )\n\n        # Max iterations reached — force a final answer from the last response\n        elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0\n        logger.warning(\n            \"Agent hit max iterations (%d) after %.1fs — using last content as answer\",\n            self.max_iterations, elapsed,\n        )\n        final_content = response.content or \"\"\n        if not final_content:\n            final_content = (\n                \"达到最大迭代次数但未生成最终内容，\"\n                \"请检查工具调用日志或重试。\"\n            )\n        return AgentResult(\n            content=final_content,\n            tool_calls_log=tool_calls_log,\n            iterations=self.max_iterations,\n        )\n\n    async def _execute_tool_calls(self, tool_calls: list[ToolCall]) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Execute a batch of tool calls, returning results in order.\"\"\"\n        tasks = [self._execute_single_tool(tc) for tc in tool_calls]\n        return await asyncio.gather(*tasks)\n\n    async def _execute_single_tool(self, tc: ToolCall) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Execute one tool call, catching all errors gracefully.\"\"\"\n        tool_def = self.registry.get(tc.function_name)\n        if tool_def is None:\n            msg = f\"未知工具: {tc.function_name}。可用工具: {self.registry.tool_names}\"\n            logger.warning(msg)\n            return msg\n\n        try:\n            result = tool_def.fn(**tc.arguments)\n            if inspect.isawaitable(result):\n                result = await result\n            return str(result)\n        except Exception as exc:\n            msg = f\"工具 {tc.function_name} 执行出错: {exc}\"\n            logger.error(msg, exc_info=True)\n            return msg\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _build_assistant_tool_message(response: ChatResponse) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Build the assistant message containing tool_calls for the conversation history.\"\"\"\n        return {\n            \"role\": \"assistant\",\n            \"content\": response.content,\n            \"tool_calls\": [\n                {\n                    \"id\": tc.id,\n                    \"type\": \"function\",\n                    \"function\": {\n                        \"name\": tc.function_name,\n                        \"arguments\": json.dumps(tc.arguments, ensure_ascii=False),\n                    },\n                }\n                for tc in response.tool_calls\n            ],\n        }\n"
}

\"Free\", \"Enterprise\",\n]\n\nLANG_NAMES: dict[str, str] = {\n    \"zh-CN\": \"简体中文\", \"zh-TW\": \"繁體中文\", \"en\": \"English\",\n    \"ja\": \"日本語\", \"ko\": \"한국어\", \"fr\": \"Français\", \"de\": \"Deutsch\",\n    \"es\": \"Español\", \"it\": \"Italiano\", \"pt\": \"Português\", \"ru\": \"Русский\",\n    \"ar\": \"العربية\", \"th\": \"ไทย\", \"vi\": \"Tiếng Việt\",\n    \"id\": \"Bahasa Indonesia\", \"ms\": \"Bahasa Melayu\",\n}\n\nAUTONOMOUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\\\n{\n  \"ai_decisions\": {\n    \"detected_intent\": \"营销意图标识符\",\n    \"chosen_tone\": \"AI 选择的语气\",\n    \"strategy_reasoning\": \"一句话说明为什么这样写（30字以内）\"\n  },\n  \"email_title\": \"邮件标题，15字以内\",\n  \"greeting\": \"称呼语\",\n  \"intro_line\": \"开场白，1-2句\",\n  \"body_paragraphs\": [\"正文段落1\", \"正文段落2\"],\n  \"highlight_title\": \"亮点区域标题\",\n  \"highlight_desc\": \"亮点区域描述\",\n  \"highlight_items\": [\"亮点1\", \"亮点2\", \"亮点3\"],\n  \"highlight_note\": \"补充说明\",\n  \"cta_text\": \"按钮文案，8字以内\",\n  "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\\app\\agent\\tools\\registry.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"Tool registry — central catalog of all Agent tools with OpenAI function schemas.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Awaitable\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nToolFunction = Callable[..., str | Awaitable[str]]\n\n\nclass ToolDef:\n    \"\"\"A registered tool: its callable + OpenAI function-calling schema.\"\"\"\n\n    __slots__ = (\"name\", \"fn\", \"schema\")\n\n    def __init__(self, name: str, fn: ToolFunction, schema: dict[str, Any]):\n        self.name = name\n        self.fn = fn\n        self.schema = schema\n\n\nclass ToolRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Holds all tool definitions and provides lookup + schema export.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._tools: dict[str, ToolDef] = {}\n\n    def register(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        description: str,\n        parameters: dict[str, Any],\n        fn: ToolFunction,\n    ) -> None:\n        schema = {\n            \"type\": \"function\",\n            \"function\": {\n                \"name\": name,\n                \"description\": description,\n                \"parameters\": parameters,\n            },\n        }\n        self._tools[name] = ToolDef(name=name, fn=fn, schema=schema)\n        logger.debug(\"Registered tool: %s\", name)\n\n    def get(self, name: str) -> ToolDef | None:\n        return self._tools.get(name)\n\n    def get_openai_schemas(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Return all tool schemas in OpenAI function-calling format.\"\"\"\n        return [t.schema for t in self._tools.values()]\n\n    @property\n    def tool_names(self) -> list[str]:\n        return list(self._tools.keys())\n\n    def __len__(self) -> int:\n        return len(self._tools)\n\n\ntool_registry = ToolRegistry()\n"
}

## Phase 1 完成总结

### 新增文件（7 个）

| 文件 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `app/agent/__init__.py` | Agent 包入口 |

### 修改文件（3 个）

| 文件 | 变更 |
|------|------|
| `app/ai_providers/base.py` | 添加 `chat_completion_with_tools()` 方法，支持 Function Calling |
| `app/services/ai_service.py` | `generate_content` 和 `generate_strategy` 改为使用 `AgentExecutor`；翻译仍用直接调用 |
| `app/config.py` | 添加 `AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS`、`KNOWLEDGE_DIR` 配置 |
| `app/services/prompt_knowledge.py` | 修复第 236 行引号语法错误 |

### 核心架构变化

**Before（prompt 注入）：** 每次调用注入全部知识 → 单次 `chat_completion` → 解析 JSON

**After（Agent tool-calling）：** 发送精简 system prompt + 9 个工具定义 → AI 按需调用工具获取知识 → 多轮迭代 → 输出 JSON

**工具清单（9 个）：** `get_decision_tree`、`get_intent_info`、`get_segment_strategy`、`get_content_pattern`、`get_localization_guide`、`get_timing_recommendation`、`get_title_formulas`、`recommend_intent`、`score_content`

**向后兼容：** `generate_content()` 接口签名不变，对前端和 API 层完全透明。

## 日志诊断结果

### 当前进度

| 分层 | 状态 | 详情 |
|------|------|------|
| **S** | 成功 (4语言) | en 成功 (第2次大循环), ja/ko/zh-TW 翻译成功 |
| **A** | **彻底失败** | en 尝试 3次×2轮 = 6次 Agent 运行，全部 JSON 解析失败，已跳过 |
| **B** | **彻底失败** | 同上，6次 Agent 运行全部解析失败，已跳过 |
| **C** | **进行中** | 已失败 1/3 次，正在第 2 次尝试 |

### 两大根因

**1. Agent 返回的不是纯 JSON（主因，导致 A/B/C 全挂）**

所有失败都是同一个错误：`Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)` — Agent 跑完 5 轮迭代后，最终输出的是自然语言文本而不是纯 JSON。模型在工具调用上花光了 5 轮迭代预算，最后一轮被迫输出时已经偏离了 JSON 格式。

**2. `score_content` 工具参数不匹配（加剧问题）**

模型会传 `intro_line`、`highlight_title` 等参数给 `score_content`，但这个函数不接受这些参数，导致报错浪费一轮迭代。例如：

> `score_content() got an unexpected keyword argument 'intro_line'`
> `score_content() got an unexpected keyword argument 'highlight_title'`

### 为什么变慢

**速度对比**：

| 模式 | 每个 segment/lang | 说明 |
|------|-------------------|------|
| 之前(无工具) | ~3-5s 一次 | 1 次 API 调用 |
| 现在(Agent) | **20-40s** 一次 | 3-5 次 API 调用（每次迭代一次） |
| 失败重试 | **~120-240s** | 3次尝试×2轮×20-40s |

是的，**工具调用是直接原因**。模型每次生成内容需要串行调用 3-5 轮 API（recommend_intent → get_segment_strategy → get_content_pattern → score_content → 最终输出），每轮 2-10 秒。而 `score_content` 报错还会额外浪费 1-2 轮。

### 建议修复方向

1. **`score_content` 加 `**kwargs` 容错**，避免参数不匹配导致浪费迭代
2. **强化最终 JSON 输出约束**，或在最后一轮 prompt 里追加"只输出纯 JSON"
3. **可选**：把常用知识（分层策略、决策树）预注入 system prompt，减少前 2 轮工具调用

 "new_string": "def build_agent_system_prompt(\n    segment: str,\n    lang: str,\n    profile_summary: str = \"\",\n    goal_hint: str = \"\",\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Build a system prompt with pre-injected domain knowledge.\n\n    Core knowledge (decision tree, segment strategy, content patterns,\n    localization guides) is embedded directly so the model can produce\n    content in 1-2 iterations instead of 3-5 tool-calling rounds.\n    \"\"\"\n    lang_name = LANG_NAMES.get(lang, lang)\n    goal_part = f\"\\n- 运营目标提示: {goal_hint}\" if goal_hint else \"\"\n    knowledge = build_knowledge_block(segment, lang)\n\n    return f\"\"\"\\\n你是 TapNow 平台的邮件营销 AI Agent，拥有完全的策略决策权。\n以下领域知识已提供，你可以直接使用，也可通过工具获取补充信息。\n\n## 目标受众 — 分层 {segment}\n{profile_summary or f'分层 {segment} 用户'}{goal_part}\n\n## 领域知识\n{knowledge}\n\n## 工作流程\n1. 根据上述知识确定营销意图和策略\n2. 如需补充信息（如其他分层策略、罕见语种本地化），可调用工具\n3. 直接输出最终 JSON 结果\n\n## 输出格式\n{AUTONOMOUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA}\n\n## 写作约束\n- 语言: {lang_name} ({lang})\n- 品牌名保持英文: {', '.join(PROTECTED_TERMS)}\n- cta_text ≤ 8 字 | email_title ≤ 15 字\n- body_paragraphs 2-3 段，每段 50-100 字\n- highlight_items 3-5 条，每条 ≤ 20 字\n\n重要：你的最终回复必须且只能是一个 JSON 对象。不要包含任何解释文字、markdown 标记或代码块标识。直接以 {{ 开头，以 }} 结尾。\"\"\""

 "new_string": "_JSON_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(r\"``​`(?:json)?\\s*\\n?([\\s\\S]*?)\\n?``​`\")\n_TRAILING_COMMA_RE = re.compile(r\",\\s*([}\\]])\")\n\n\ndef _extract_json(raw: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Extract a JSON object from an AI response, with multiple fallback strategies.\"\"\"\n    text = raw.strip()\n    if not text:\n        raise json.JSONDecodeError(\"Empty response\", text, 0)\n\n    # Strategy 1: try direct parse (ideal case — pure JSON output)\n    if text.startswith(\"{\"):\n        try:\n            return json.loads(text)\n        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n            pass\n\n    # Strategy 2: extract from markdown code fence\n    m = _JSON_BLOCK_RE.search(text)\n    if m:\n        fenced = m.group(1).strip()\n        try:\n            return json.loads(fenced)\n        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n            text = fenced  # use fenced content for subsequent strategies\n\n    # Strategy 3: locate the outermost { ... } block\n    start = text.find(\"{\")\n    if start != -1:\n        depth = 0\n        end = start\n        for i in range(start, len(text)):\n            if text[i] == \"{\":\n                depth += 1\n            elif text[i] == \"}\":\n                depth -= 1\n                if depth == 0:\n                    end = i\n                    break\n        candidate = text[start: end + 1]\n        try:\n            return json.loads(candidate)\n        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n            # Strategy 4: repair common issues (trailing commas, single quotes)\n            repaired = candidate.replace(\"'\", '\"')\n            repaired = _TRAILING_COMMA_RE.sub(r\"\\1\", repaired)\n            try:\n                return json.loads(repaired)\n            except json.JSONDecodeError:\n                pass\n\n    raise json.JSONDecodeError(\n        f\"No valid JSON object found in response (length={len(raw)})\", raw[:200], 0,\n    )"

\"Free\")\n\n    if registered_days_ago <= 7 and active_days_ago > 3:\n        return \"new_inactive\"\n    if registered_days_ago <= 14 and active_days_ago <= 3:\n        return \"onboarding\"\n    if active_days_ago <= 3 and plan != \"Free\":\n        return \"power_user\"\n    if active_days_ago <= 7:\n        return \"active\"\n    if active_days_ago <= 30:\n        return \"declining\"\n 2),\n        feature_adoption_depth=_infer_feature_adoption(plan, active_days_ago),\n        churn_risk=_infer_churn_risk(lifecycle, active_days_ago),\n        language=user.get(\"lang\", \"en\"),\n The AI Strategy Planner can further\n    refine or merge these groups based on the full profile data.\n    \"\"\"\n    groups: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    for idx, tags in enumerate(tags_list):\n str] = {\n    \"loyal_power_users\": \"忠诚的高价值付费用户\",\n    \"paid_active_users\": \"活跃付费用户\",\n    \"active_free_users\": \"活跃免费用户\",\n    \"casual_free_users\": \"低频免费用户\",\n    \"new_users\": \"\"\"Aggregate behavioral signals for an audience group.\"\"\"\n    if not users:\n        return {\"population\": 0}\n\n    total = len(users)\n    active_days = [u.get(\"active_days_ago\", 999) for Counter(detect_lifecycle_stage(u) for u in users)\n\n    new_inactive_pct = round(lifecycle_counter.get(\"new_inactive\", 0) / total * 100)\n    churned_pct = round(lifecycle_counter.get(\"churned\", lifecycle_counter.get(\"power_user\", 0))\n        / total * 100\n    )\n\n    signals: dict[str, object] = {\n        \"population\": total,\n        \"lifecycle_distribution\": {\n            stage: count for stage, count in lifecycle_counter.most_common()\n        },\n        \"median_active_days_ago\": round(median(active_days)),\n        \"median_registered_days_ago\": round(median(registered_days)),\n        \"active_pct\": active_pct,\n        \"declining_pct\": declining_pct,\n        \"churned_pct\": churned_pct,\n        \"new_inactive_pct\": new_inactive_pct,\n    }\n\n    facts: list[str] = []\n    if new_inactive_pct >= 10:\n        facts.append(f\"{new_inactive_pct}% 用户注册后几乎未使用\")\n    if churned_pct >= 20:\n        facts.append(f\"{churned_pct}% 用户已流失（超过90天未活跃）\")\n    if declining_pct >= 15:\n        facts.append(f\"{declining_pct}% 用户活跃度正在下降\")\n    if active_pct >= 50:\n        facts.append(f\"{active_pct}% )\n\n\ndef _build_group_characteristics(\n    group_id: str,\n    user_dicts: list[dict],\n    tags: list[UserBehaviorTags],\n) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Build key characteristic strings for a group.\"\"\"\n    n = len(tags)\n    if n == 0:\n        return []\n    paid_pct = round(sum(1 for t in tags if t.is_paid) / n * 100)\n    avg_days = round(sum(t.days_since_active for t in tags) / top_lifecycle, top_count = lifecycle_counter.most_common(1)[0]\n    stage_label = LIFECYCLE_STAGES.get(top_lifecycle, top_lifecycle)\n    characteristics.append(f\"主要处于「{stage_label}」阶段({round(top_count / n * 100)}%)\")\n    return characteristics\n\n\ndef build_audience_profile(users: list[dict], active_within_days: int = 30) -> round(g_paid / len(group_tags), 2)\n        g_plan_counter: Counter[str] = Counter(t.subscription_plan for t in group_tags)\n        top_plans = [p for p, _ in g_plan_counter.most_common(3) if p != ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Tool implementations\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef get_strategy_framework() -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the full strategy methodology framework.\"\"\"\n    return STRATEGY_FRAMEWORK\n\n\ndef get_intent_info(intent: str = \"\") -> str:\n    if not intent:\n        lines = [\"可选意图列表（参考，你也可以自定义意图）:\"]\n        for iid, info in INTENT_DEFINITIONS.items():\n            primary, alt = INTENT_TONE_MAP.get(iid, (\"专业友好\", \"\"))\n            lines.append(\n                f\"- {iid}({info['name']}): {info['purpose']}  \"\n                f\"受众={info['audience']}  推荐语气=「{primary}」备选=「{alt}」\"\n            )\n        return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n\n    info = INTENT_DEFINITIONS.get(intent)\n    if not info:\n        return f\"未知意图: {intent}。可选: {', '.join(INTENT_DEFINITIONS.keys())}\"\n    primary, alt = INTENT_TONE_MAP.get(intent, (\"专业友好\", \"\"))\n    return (\n        f\"意图: {intent} ({info['name']})\\n\"\n        f\"目的: {info['purpose']}\\n\"\n        f\"目标受众: {info['audience']}\\n\"\n        f\"推荐语气: {primary}\\n\"\n        f\"备选语气: {alt}\"\n    )\n\n\ndef get_content_pattern(intent: str) -> str:\n    pattern = CONTENT_PATTERNS.get(intent)\n    if not pattern:\n        return f\"未知意图: {intent}。可选: {', '.join(CONTENT_PATTERNS.keys())}\"\n    name = INTENT_DEFINITIONS.get(intent, {}).get(\"name\", intent)\n    return f\"## 内容模式 — {name}\\n{pattern}\"\n\n\ndef get_localization_guide(language: str) -> str:\n    guide = LOCALIZATION_GUIDES.get(language)\n    if not guide:\n        available = \", \".join(LOCALIZATION_GUIDES.keys())\n        return f\"无 {language} 的本地化指南。已有: {available}\"\n    return f\"## {language} 本地化要点\\n{guide}\"\n\n\ndef get_timing_recommendation(intent: str = \"\") -> str:\n    if intent:\n        t = TIMING_WINDOWS.get(intent)\n        if not t:\n            return f\"未知意图: {intent}。可选: {', '.join(TIMING_WINDOWS.keys())}\"\n        return (\n            f\"发送时机 — {intent}:\\n\"\n            f\"最佳日期: {t['best_day']}\\n\"\n            f\"最佳时段: {t['best_hour']}\\n\"\n            f\"原因: {t['reason']}\"\n        )\n    lines = [\"各意图发送时机推荐:\"]\n    for iid, t in TIMING_WINDOWS.items():\n        lines.append(f\"- {iid}: {t['best_day']} {t['best_hour']} — {t['reason']}\")\n    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n\n\ndef get_title_formulas() -> str:\n    return TITLE_FORMULAS\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Auto-register all knowledge tools\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_strategy_framework\",\n    description=\"获取策略制定方法论框架，包含分析维度和策略原则\",\n    parameters={\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {}, \"required\": []},\n    fn=get_strategy_framework,\n)\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_intent_info\",\n    description=\"获取特定营销意图的详细信息（目的、受众、推荐语气）。不传参数则返回所有意图列表\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"intent\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"意图标识，如 new_user_onboarding, churn_recall, upsell 等。留空返回全部\",\n            },\n        },\n    },\n    fn=get_intent_info,\n)\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_content_pattern\",\n    description=\"获取特定意图对应的邮件内容写作模式（结构、段落安排、标题公式）\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"intent\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"意图标识，如 new_user_onboarding, churn_recall 等\",\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"intent\"],\n    },\n    fn=get_content_pattern,\n)\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_localization_guide\",\n    description=\"获取特定语言的本地化指南（称谓、文化偏好、CTA翻译、禁忌等）\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"language\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"语言代码，如 ja, ko, fr, de, es, zh-TW, ar 等\",\n            },\n        },\n        \"required\": [\"language\"],\n    },\n    fn=get_localization_guide,\n)\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_timing_recommendation\",\n    description=\"获取邮件发送时机建议（最佳日期、时段及原因）。不传参数返回所有意图的时机推荐\",\n    parameters={\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": {\n            \"intent\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"意图标识。留空返回全部意图的时机推荐\",\n            },\n        },\n    },\n    fn=get_timing_recommendation,\n)\n\ntool_registry.register(\n    name=\"get_title_formulas\",\n    description=\"获取邮件标题写作公式（好奇心驱动、利益驱动、紧迫感等六种模式及质量要求）\",\n    parameters={\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {}, \"required\": []},\n    fn=get_title_formulas,\n)\n"
}

result[\"source\"] = \"churn_risk\"\n            result[\"confidence\"] = \"medium\"\n        else:\n            result[\"intent\"] = \"feature_announcement\"\n            result[\"source\"] = \"fallback\"\n            result[\"confidence\"] = \"low\"\n\n    chosen = result.get(\"intent\", \"\")\n    primary, alt = INTENT_TONE_MAP.get(chosen, (\"专业友好\", \"\"))\n    result[\"recommended_tone\"] = primary\n    result[\"alternative_tone\"] = alt\n\n    return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n\n\n# \"description\": \"付费用户比例 (0-1)\",\n            },\n            \"dominant_lifecycle\": {\n                \"type\": \"string\",\n                \"description\": \"主要生命周期阶段:        logger.error(\"Content generation failed: %s\", exc)\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,\n            detail=f\"AI content generation failed: {exc}\",\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:\n        logger.exception(\"Unexpected error during content generation\")\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,\n            detail=f\"AI provider error: {exc}\",\n        )\n\n    return GenerateContentResponse(\n        group_id=req.group_id or req.segment,\n \"X-Accel-Buffering\": \"no\",\n        },\n    )\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# POST /ai/translate  —  Manual: single language translation\n# ai_service.translate_content(\n            content=req.content,\n            source_lang=req.source_lang,\n            target_lang=req.target_lang,\n            segment=req.group_id or req.segment,\n detail=f\"AI translation failed: {exc}\",\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:\n        logger.exception(\"Unexpected error during translation\")\n        raise HTTPException(\n target_lang=lang,\n        group_id=req.group_id,\n        segment=req.segment,\n        content=translated,\n    )\n"

 "contents": "/**\n * Real backend AI API client — multi-agent pipeline.\n * AI autonomously groups users, decides strategies, and generates content.\n */\nimport type { AIDecisions, AudienceProfile, ContentFields, SegmentProfile } from '../../types';\n\nconst BASE = '/api';\n\nfunction authHeaders(): Record<string, string> {\n  const token = localStorage.getItem('edm_token');\n  return {\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n    ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction toBackendGroupProfile(sp: SegmentProfile) {\n  return {\n    group_id: sp.groupId ?? '',\n    group_label: sp.groupLabel ?? '',\n    count: sp.count,\n    paid_ratio: sp.paidRatio,\n    top_plans: sp.topPlans,\n    character_summary: sp.characterSummary,\n    key_characteristics: sp.keyCharacteristics ?? [],\n    suggested_priority: sp.suggestedPriority ?? 'medium',\n    avg_tags: {},\n  };\n}\n\nfunction toBackendAudienceProfile(ap: AudienceProfile) {\n  const profiles = ap.groupProfiles ?? ap.segmentProfiles;\n  const group_profiles: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof toBackendGroupProfile>> = {};\n  for (const [gid, profile] of Object.entries(profiles)) {\n    group_profiles[gid] = toBackendGroupProfile(profile);\n  }\n  return {\n    total: ap.total,\n    top_languages: ap.topLanguages,\n    group_profiles,\n    audience_summary: ap.audienceSummary,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction parseAIDecisions(raw: Record<string, unknown>): AIDecisions {\n  return {\n    detectedIntent: (raw.detected_intent as string) ?? '',\n    chosenTone: (raw.chosen_tone as string) ?? '',\n    strategyReasoning: (raw.strategy_reasoning as string) ?? '',\n    groupId: (raw.group_id as string) ?? '',\n    contentFocus: (raw.content_focus as string[]) ?? [],\n  };\n}\n\n// ── Single content generation ───────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport async function apiGenerateContent(params: {\n  campaignId: string;\n  material: string;\n  segment: string;\n  lang: string;\n  segmentProfile?: SegmentProfile | null;\n  goalHint?: string;\n  ctaUrl?: string;\n}): Promise<{ content: ContentFields; aiDecisions: AIDecisions }> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/generate-content`, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n    body: JSON.stringify({\n      campaign_id: params.campaignId,\n      material: params.material,\n      group_id: params.segment,\n      segment: params.segment,\n      lang: params.lang,\n      group_profile: params.segmentProfile\n        ? toBackendGroupProfile(params.segmentProfile)\n        : null,\n      goal_hint: params.goalHint ?? '',\n      cta_url: params.ctaUrl ?? null,\n    }),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n    throw new Error(err.detail ?? `AI 生成失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  }\n  const data = await resp.json() as {\n    content: ContentFields;\n    ai_decisions?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  };\n  return {\n    content: data.content,\n    aiDecisions: parseAIDecisions(data.ai_decisions ?? {}),\n  };\n}\n\n// ── Translation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport async function apiTranslateContent(params: {\n  content: ContentFields;\n  sourceLang: string;\n  targetLang: string;\n  segment?: string;\n}): Promise<ContentFields> {\n  const resp = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/translate`, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: authHeaders(),\n    body: JSON.stringify({\n      content: params.content,\n      source_lang: params.sourceLang,\n      target_lang: params.targetLang,\n      group_id: params.segment ?? '',\n      segment: params.segment ?? '',\n    }),\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const err = await resp.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n    throw new Error(err.detail ?? `AI 翻译失败 (${resp.status})`);\n  }\n  const data = await resp.json() as { content: ContentFields };\n  return data.content;\n}\n\n// ── Auto-generate (SSE streaming, multi-agent pipeline) ─────────────────\n\nexport interface AutoGenerateCallbacks {\n  onStrategy: (segment: string, strategy: string) => void;\n  onAIDecision: (segment: string, decisions: AIDecisions) => void;\n  onContentReady: (segment: string, lang: string, content: ContentFields) => void;\n  onProgress: (segment: string, lang: string, status: 'pending' | 'loading' | 'done' | 'error') => void;\n  onDone: (total: number, completed: number) => void;\n  onError?: (err: Error) => void;\n  onSegmentError?: (segment: string, lang: string, message: string) => void;\n  onGroupDefined?: (groupId: string, label: string, count: number, characteristics: string[]) => void;\n  onProfilingComplete?: (totalGroups: number, totalUsers: number) => void;\n}\n\nexport async function apiAutoGenerate(\n  params: {\n    campaignId: string;\n    material: string;\n    goalHint: string;\n    ctaUrl: string;\n    baseLang: string;\n    audienceProfile: AudienceProfile;\n  },\n  callbacks: AutoGenerateCallbacks,\n  signal?: AbortSignal,\n): Promise<void> {\n  const profiles = params.audienceProfile.groupProfiles ?? params.audienceProfile.segmentProfiles;\n  for (const seg of Object.keys(profiles)) {\n    for (const lang of params.audienceProfile.topLanguages) {\n      callbacks.onProgress(seg, lang, 'pending');\n    }\n  }\n\n  const token = localStorage.getItem('edm_token');\n\n  try {\n    const response = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/auto-generate`, {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),\n      },\n      body: JSON.stringify({\n        campaign_id: params.campaignId,\n        material: params.material,\n        goal_hint: params.goalHint,\n        cta_url: params.ctaUrl,\n        base_lang: params.baseLang,\n        audience_profile: toBackendAudienceProfile(params.audienceProfile),\n      }),\n      signal,\n    });\n\n    if (!response.ok || !response.body) {\n      const err = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as { detail?: string };\n      if (response.status === 401) {\n        throw new Error(\n          err.detail === 'Token 已过期' || err.detail === '无效的 Token'\n            ? `${err.detail}，请重新登录后再试`\n            : '登录已失效（401），请重新登录后再试',\n        );\n      }\n      if (response.status === 403) {\n        throw new Error(\n          typeof err.detail === 'string' && err.detail\n            ? err.detail\n            : '未登录或无权访问，请先登录后再试',\n        );\n      }\n      throw new Error(err.detail ?? `AI 自动生成失败 (${response.status})`);\n    }\n\n    const reader = response.body.getReader();\n    const decoder = new TextDecoder();\n    let buffer = '';\n\n    while (true) {\n      const { done, value } = await reader.read();\n      if (done) break;\n      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });\n      const lines = buffer.split('\\n');\n      buffer = lines.pop() ?? '';\n\n      for (const line of lines) {\n        const trimmed = line.trim();\n        if (!trimmed.startsWith('data:')) continue;\n        try {\n          const evt = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(5)) as Record<string, unknown>;\n          switch (evt.event) {\n            case 'profiling_complete': {\n              callbacks.onProfilingComplete?.(\n                evt.total_groups as number,\n                evt.total_users as number,\n              );\n              break;\n            }\n            case 'group_defined': {\n              const gid = (evt.group_id ?? evt.segment) as string;\n              callbacks.onGroupDefined?.(\n                gid,\n                evt.group_label as string,\n                evt.count as number,\n                (evt.key_characteristics as string[]) ?? [],\n              );\n              break;\n            }\n            case 'strategy': {\n              const seg = (evt.group_id ?? evt.segment) as string;\n              for (const lang of params.audienceProfile.topLanguages) {\n                callbacks.onProgress(seg, lang, 'loading');\n              }\n              callbacks.onStrategy(seg, evt.strategy as string);\n              break;\n            }\n            case 'ai_decision': {\n              const seg = (evt.group_id ?? evt.segment) as string;\n              const decisions = parseAIDecisions(evt.decisions as Record<string, unknown>);\n              callbacks.onAIDecision(seg, decisions);\n              break;\n            }\n            case 'content_ready': {\n              const seg = (evt.group_id ?? evt.segment) as string;\n              callbacks.onProgress(seg, evt.lang as string, 'done');\n              callbacks.onContentReady(\n                seg,\n                evt.lang as string,\n                evt.data as ContentFields,\n              );\n              break;\n            }\n            case 'error': {\n              const seg = (evt.group_id ?? evt.segment) as string;\n              callbacks.onProgress(\n                seg,\n                (evt.lang as string) ?? 'unknown',\n                'error',\n              );\n              callbacks.onSegmentError?.(\n                seg,\n                (evt.lang as string) ?? 'unknown',\n                (evt.message as string) ?? '生成失败',\n              );\n              break;\n            }\n            case 'done': {\n              const summary = evt.summary as { total: number; completed: number };\n              callbacks.onDone(summary.total, summary.completed);\n              break;\n            }\n          }\n        } catch {\n          // skip malformed SSE events\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (signal?.aborted) return;\n    callbacks.onError?.(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)));\n  }\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "---\nname: edm-marketing-agent\ndescription: >\n  EDM 邮件营销多 Agent 管线的领域知识库与决策框架。涵盖行为标签体系、\n  自主分组策略、多 Agent 协作流程、内容模式标准和多语言本地化。当进行以下操作时触发：\n  (1) 创建或优化 EDM 营销活动——需要分析用户群组、制定策略、生成内容时；\n  (2) 修改 ai_service.py 中的多 Agent 管线逻辑时；\n  (3) 调整用户行为标签体系或自动分组规则时；\n  (4) 改进 Strategy Planner 或 Content Writer Agent 的 prompt 时；\n  (5) 处理多语言翻译和本地化营销文案时；\n  (6) 讨论发送时机、频率控制、受众生命周期管理时。\n  产品上下文：TapNow 平台，使用 FastAPI 后端 + React 前端 + 多 AI Provider 架构。\n---\n\n# EDM Marketing Multi-Agent Pipeline\n\n邮件营销多 Agent 管线知识库，为 AI 自主决策提供灵活的方法论框架。\n\n## 核心架构：三阶段 Agent 管线\n\n``​`\n输入层                    Multi-Agent Pipeline                    输出层\n┌──────────┐   ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐   ┌──────────┐\n│ 收件人数据 │──→│ Agent 1: Data Profiler (audience_service) │   │          │\n│ 活动素材   │   │   行为标签计算 + 自动分组                   │   │  SSE 流  │\n│ 运营目标   │   │                                          │   │ 逐组逐语言│\n└──────────┘   │ Agent 2: Strategy Planner                 │──→│ 推送内容  │\n               │   分析群组画像 → 制定差异化策略              │   │          │\n               │                                          │   │          │\n               │ Agent 3: Content Writer                   │   │          │\n               │   根据策略 + 画像生成邮件内容               │   │          │\n               └──────────────────────────────────────────┘   └──────────┘\n``​`\n\n## 关键文件\n\n``​`\nedm-backend/app/\n├── services/\n│   ├── ai_service.py          # 多 Agent 管线编排 (plan_strategies + generate_content + translate)\n│   ├── audience_service.py    # 行为标签计算 (build_behavior_tags) + 自动分组 (_auto_group_users)\n│   ├── prompt_knowledge.py    # 策略方法论框架 + 意图/内容/本地化知识\n│   ├── campaign_service.py    # 活动 CRUD + 状态机\n│   └── send_service.py        # 发送执行 + 排期\n├── agent/\n│   ├── prompts.py             # 三个 Agent 的 system/user prompt 构建\n│   ├── executor.py            # tool-calling 循环\n│   └── tools/                 # knowledge, analysis, content 工具\n├── schemas/\n│   └── ai.py                  # UserBehaviorTags, UserGroupProfile, GroupStrategy, AIDecisions\n└── models/\n    ├── campaign_content.py    # group_id 替代 segment\n    └── campaign_segment.py    # group_id + strategy_json\n``​`\n\n## 行为标签体系（替代 SABC）\n\n用户不再被硬分为 S/A/B/C 四级，而是计算多维行为标签：\n\n| 维度 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|------|------|------|\n| lifecycle_stage | 分类 | new_inactive → onboarding → active → power_user → declining → dormant → churned |\n| activity_level | 数值 0-1 | 综合活跃度评分 |\n| subscription_plan | 分类 | Free / Basic / Pro / Premium / Enterprise |\n| payment_willingness | 分类 | high / medium / low / none |\n| engagement_score | 数值 0-1 | 综合互动评分 |\n| feature_adoption_depth | 分类 | shallow / moderate / deep |\n| churn_risk | 分类 | low / medium / high / critical |\n\n## 自动分组规则\n\n`audience_service._auto_group_users()` 基于行为标签产生初始分组：\n\n- **loyal_power_users** — 付费 + 高活跃 (activity_level >= 0.8)\n- **paid_active_users** — 付费 + 一般活跃\n- **active_free_users** — 免费 + 较高活跃 (activity_level >= 0.7)\n- **casual_free_users** — 免费 + 低活跃\n- **new_users** — new_inactive / onboarding 阶段\n- **declining_users** — declining 阶段\n- **dormant_users** — dormant 阶段\n- **churned_users** — churned 阶段\n\nAI Strategy Planner 可在此基础上进一步细分或合并。\n\n## Workflow\n\n### 1. 创建营销活动（多 Agent 管线）\n\n1. **受众分析** (Agent 1 / Data Profiler)\n   - `audience_service.build_audience_profile()` 计算行为标签并自动分组\n   - 输出 `UserGroupProfile` 集合，包含每组的统计数据和平均行为标签\n\n2. **策略制定** (Agent 2 / Strategy Planner)\n   - `ai_service.plan_strategies()` 将群组画像发给 LLM\n   - LLM 根据 `STRATEGY_FRAMEWORK` 方法论自主制定每组的 `GroupStrategy`\n   - 输出包含: 意图、语气、内容重点、CTA方向、避讳清单、个性化建议\n\n3. **内容生成** (Agent 3 / Content Writer)\n   - `ai_service.generate_content()` 接收策略 + 画像\n   - 严格按策略方案撰写邮件内容\n   - 逐组逐语言生成，非基础语言通过翻译 Agent 完成\n\n4. **SSE 事件流**\n   ``​`\n   profiling_complete → group_defined → strategy → ai_decision → content_ready → done\n   ``​`\n\n### 2. 修改 Prompt / 后端逻辑\n\n修改 Agent prompt 时：\n\n1. 确认要改哪个 Agent（Strategy Planner / Content Writer / 翻译）\n2. 对应的 prompt 函数在 `agent/prompts.py`\n3. 策略方法论在 `prompt_knowledge.py` 的 `STRATEGY_FRAMEWORK`\n4. 保持输出 JSON 与 `GroupStrategy` / `ContentFields` / `AIDecisions` 兼容\n\n### 3. 调整分组规则\n\n- 修改 `audience_service._auto_group_users()` 中的分组逻辑\n- 或调整 `build_behavior_tags()` 中的标签计算规则\n- 新增分组需在 `_GROUP_LABELS` 中添加中文标签\n\n## 关键约束\n\n- **品牌名不翻译**：TapNow, Pro, Premium, Basic, Free, Enterprise\n- **输出格式**：严格 JSON，无 markdown 包裹\n- **CTA 文案**：≤ 8 字/词\n- **邮件标题**：≤ 15 字\n- **正文段落**：2-3 段，每段 50-100 字\n- **亮点条目**：3-5 条，每条 ≤ 20 字\n- **策略自主权**：AI Agent 不受预设分级限制，可自由制定策略\n"
}

## 假设列表

**H2 (严重): `send_service.py` 测试发送也坏了**

Let me identify the bugs I've found through code review:

**Bug 1: `send_service.py` uses `CampaignContent.segment` instead of `CampaignContent.group_id` for content lookup**

In `send_service.py`:
- Line 234: `CampaignContent.segment == segment` — but now `segment` is a nullable optional field while `group_id` is the primary identifier. If content was saved using `group_id` (like "loyal_power_users"), but `segment` was set to that same value OR not set at all, this query will fail.


- Line 298 and 316 also key lookups by `segment` and `segment_code` respectively, which are now optional or legacy fields, creating inconsistency across the codebase.

Looking at how `segment` gets populated, I see in `campaign_service.py` that `segment` is being set to the same value as `group_id` during creation, but in `send_service.py` line 155, the recipient's segment is being used directly, which could be `None` or mismatched from the actual content grouping.

The core issue is that `CampaignContent` stores segment as the group_id value (like "loyal_power_users"), but when looking up content during send processing, the code uses the recipient's original segment field which might contain old-style codes like "S" or "A", causing the lookup to fail because the keys don't match.

There's also a similar problem in the test rendering function and in how segment configurations are keyed — the code is still trying to use `segment_code` which is now legacy, when it should be using `group_id` instead.

The `SendLog` model is still storing the old SABC `segment` value from the recipient, not the new `group_id`, which means the logging and any downstream lookups based on that field will be misaligned.

Additionally, the `AudienceProfile` schema in `schemas/ai.py` is missing several fields that exist in the recipient schema version, like the breakdown fields for segments, groups, languages, and plan types.

When the frontend sends an audience profile to `auto_generate`, it only includes the fields that match the AI schema definition, so that part works fine. But the audience service returns the fuller recipient schema version, which the frontend then converts back down when making the auto-generate request — and the backend's schema validation will only accept the subset of fields it expects.

Let me trace through the actual field names more carefully. The frontend has both `segmentProfiles` and `groupProfiles`, and when it sends data to the backend, it's using `group_profiles` from the camelCase conversion. The backend's `AudienceProfile` in the AI schema expects `group_profiles`, so that should align. Since Pydantic ignores extra fields by default, any mismatch shouldn't break things.

Now I need to focus on the actual bugs I've identified. There's still an issue in `report_service.py` where `_build_by_segment` is querying by something that needs to be fixed.

Looking at the critical path in `send_service.py`, I'm seeing the real problems: the content lookup is comparing `c.segment` (which gets set to group_id) against `r.segment` (which is either the old SABC value or empty), so content won't be found for recipients during send. Similarly, the segment config lookup is using `s.segment_code` which is a legacy field. These are the blocking issues that would prevent the send from working at all.

When I trace through `mock_recipients.py` and how it feeds into the system, the mock data generates recipients with the old segment values like "S"/"A"/"B"/"C", and those values persist through the query and list creation process. But then during send, the content lookup fails because it's trying to match against group IDs instead of these old segment values.

The real issue is that there's no stored mapping between recipients and their computed group IDs — the grouping happens dynamically in the audience service, but by send time that information is lost. I need to either store the group ID on each recipient when the list is created, recompute the grouping at send time, or maintain a separate mapping table.

{data}\")\n        return ChatResponse.from_openai(choices[0])\n\n    async def close(self) -> None:\n        await self._client.aclose()"
}

Now I need to connect the `KnowledgeStore` YAML data to the Agent tool system. Currently, the Agent tools in `knowledge.py` use hardcoded data from `prompt_knowledge.py`. I need to add a new tool that lets the Agent query the YAML knowledge store, which allows dynamically loaded/updated YAML data to be available to the Agent.

 "old_string": "def require_role(*allowed_roles: str):\n    \"\"\"Decorator for route handlers that restricts access to specific roles.\n\n    Usage::\n\n        @router.get(\"/admin-only\")\n        @require_role(\"admin\")\n        async def admin_endpoint(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):\n            ...\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def decorator(func):\n        @wraps(func)\n        async def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n            user: User | None = kwargs.get(\"user\")\n            if user is None:\n                raise TokenInvalidException()\n            if user.role not in allowed_roles:\n                raise ForbiddenException(f\"需要以下角色之一: {', '.join(allowed_roles)}\")\n            return await func(*args, **kwargs)\n\n        return wrapper\n\n    return decorator",
 "new_string": "def require_role(*allowed_roles: str):\n    \"\"\"Decorator for route handlers that restricts access to specific roles.\n\n    Usage::\n\n        @router.get(\"/admin-only\")\n        @require_role(\"admin\")\n        async def admin_endpoint(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):\n            ...\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def decorator(func):\n        sig = inspect.signature(func)\n        param_names = list(sig.parameters.keys())\n        user_idx = param_names.index(\"user\") if \"user\" in param_names else -1\n\n        @wraps(func)\n        async def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):\n            user: User | None = kwargs.get(\"user\")\n            if user is None and user_idx >= 0 and user_idx < len(args):\n                user = args[user_idx]\n            if user is None:\n                raise TokenInvalidException()\n            if user.role not in allowed_roles:\n                raise ForbiddenException(f\"需要以下角色之一: {', '.join(allowed_roles)}\")\n            return await func(*args, **kwargs)\n\n        return wrapper\n\n    return decorator"
}

## Debug 完成总结

### 1. 发送服务 -> 报表数据断链 (严重)
**文件**: `app/services/send_service.py`
**问题**: `_process_send_task` 发送邮件后只更新 `SendLog`，从不更新 `Recipient.ses_status` 和 `sent_at`，而报表系统 (`report_service`) 完全依赖 `Recipient` 表统计，导致报表永远显示 0。
**修复**: 发送每封邮件后同步更新对应 `Recipient` 的 `ses_status` 和 `sent_at`。

### 2. 活动副本丢失 AI 内容 (严重)
**文件**: `app/services/campaign_service.py`
**问题**: `duplicate_campaign` 的 `content_fields` 列表缺少 `subject`、`preheader`、`html_body`，AI 生成的新模式内容在复制时全部丢失。
**修复**: 补全这三个字段到复制列表。

### 3. Gemini Provider 工具调用无效 (严重)
**文件**: `app/ai_providers/gemini_provider.py`
**问题**: `GeminiProvider` 直接继承 `AIProvider` 但未覆盖 `chat_completion_with_tools`，基类默认实现会忽略所有 tools，导致选用 Gemini 时 Agent 工具循环完全失效。
**修复**: 实现完整的 `chat_completion_with_tools`，支持 OpenAI 兼容的工具调用协议。

### 4. Skills API 的 `settings` 引用隐患
**文件**: `app/api/skills.py`
**问题**: `from app.config import settings` 放在文件第 201 行（函数定义之后），虽然运行时因模块完整加载通常不报错，但违反 Python 导入规范，在特殊情况下可能触发 `NameError`。
**修复**: 将 import 移到文件顶部，删除底部的冗余 import。

### 5. `AgentResult` 双重定义
**文件**: `app/agent/executor.py` + `app/agent/models.py`
**问题**: executor 中定义了 `@dataclass AgentResult`，models 中定义了 `BaseModel AgentResult`，同名不同类，跨模块引用时极易混淆。
**修复**: 删除 executor 中的 dataclass 版本，统一使用 `models.py` 中的 Pydantic 版本。

### 6. SSE 客户端缺少鉴权
**文件**: `edm-frontend/src/utils/sseClient.ts`
**问题**: `consumeSSE` 发起 POST 请求时不携带 `Authorization` 头，与后端的 JWT 保护不匹配。
**修复**: 从 `localStorage` 读取 token 并添加 `Authorization: Bearer` 头。

### 7. YAML 知识库与 Agent 脱节 (功能缺失)
**文件**: `app/agent/tools/knowledge.py`
**问题**: 通过 Skills API 管理的 YAML 知识库（`KnowledgeStore`）与 Agent 工具系统完全隔离。Agent 只能访问 `prompt_knowledge.py` 中的静态数据，编辑 YAML 文件对 Agent 行为没有任何影响。
**修复**: 新增两个 Agent 工具 `query_knowledge_entry` 和 `list_knowledge_entries`，让 Agent 能动态查询 YAML 知识库。

### 8. `require_role` 装饰器脆弱
**文件**: `app/core/dependencies.py`
**问题**: 只通过 `kwargs.get("user")` 查找用户，如果 FastAPI 通过位置参数传入则找不到。
**修复**: 使用 `inspect.signature` 在装饰时确定参数位置，运行时同时检查 `kwargs` 和 `args`。

### 验证结果
- 65 个 Python 模块全部导入成功
- 9 个 Agent 工具正确注册（含 2 个新增 YAML 工具）
- 30 个 YAML 知识条目正常加载
- 56 个 FastAPI 路由正确挂载
- 所有修复点的连通性测试全部通过

 "contents": "\"\"\"Tencent Cloud SES SMTP client — async wrapper around smtplib.\n\nUses SMTP_SSL (port 465) with the credentials obtained from the\nTencent Cloud SES console.  Activate by setting SES_SMTP_USER and\nSES_SMTP_PASSWORD in .env.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport smtplib\nimport uuid\nfrom email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart\nfrom email.mime.text import MIMEText\nfrom functools import partial\n\nfrom app.config import settings\nfrom app.core.logging_config import get_logger\nfrom app.services.ses_client import SESResult\n\nlogger = get_logger(\"tencent_smtp\")\n\n_SMTP_HOST = \"smtp.qcloudmail.com\"\n_SMTP_PORT = 465\n\n\nclass TencentSMTPClient:\n    \"\"\"Send email via Tencent Cloud SES SMTP over SSL/TLS.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, smtp_user: str, smtp_password: str) -> None:\n        self._user = smtp_user\n        self._password = ***REDACTED***\n        logger.info(\"TencentSMTPClient initialised | user=%s\", smtp_user)\n\n    def _build_from_header(self, from_email: str) -> str:\n        if settings.SES_FROM_EMAIL_NAME:\n            return f\"{settings.SES_FROM_EMAIL_NAME} <{from_email}>\"\n        return from_email\n\n    def _send_sync(\n        self,\n        to_email: str,\n        subject: str,\n        html_content: str,\n        from_email: str,\n    ) -> SESResult:\n        msg = MIMEMultipart(\"alternative\")\n        msg[\"Subject\"] = subject\n        msg[\"From\"] = self._build_from_header(from_email)\n        msg[\"To\"] = to_email\n        msg.attach(MIMEText(html_content, \"html\", \"utf-8\"))\n\n        try:\n            with smtplib.SMTP_SSL(_SMTP_HOST, _SMTP_PORT, timeout=30) as server:\n                server.login(self._user, self._password)\n                server.sendmail(from_email, [to_email], msg.as_bytes())\n            message_id = f\"ses-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]}\"\n            logger.debug(\"Tencent SMTP sent | to=%s mid=%s\", to_email, message_id)\n            return SESResult(message_id=message_id, success=True)\n        except Exception as exc:\n            logger.error(\"Tencent SMTP send failed | to=%s error=%s\", to_email, exc)\n            return SESResult(message_id=\"\", success=False, error=str(exc))\n\n    async def send_email(\n        self,\n        to_email: str,\n        subject: str,\n        html_content: str,\n        from_email: str | None = None,\n    ) -> SESResult:\n        sender = from_email or settings.SES_FROM_EMAIL\n        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()\n        return await loop.run_in_executor(\n            None,\n            partial(self._send_sync, to_email, subject, html_content, sender),\n        )\n"
}

### 🤖 Agent

我注意到你的选择里有一个**重要风险**需要先跟你确认，否则一旦执行可能损伤发信域名信誉。

**风险点：** 发 100 封给 `test001@example.com ~ test100@example.com` 这类虚构地址，腾讯云 SES 大概率会把它们全部记为**硬退信（Hard Bounce）**。对于一个还在"预热"阶段的新发信域名（`updates.tapnow.ai`），一次性制造 100 条硬退信会：

1. **严重拉低域名信誉分**，导致后续发给真实用户的邮件也更容易进垃圾箱
2. 可能触发腾讯云 SES **风控限额甚至临时暂停发信权限**
3. 收件方邮件服务商（Gmail / QQ / 163 等）也可能因此拉黑你的发信域名

行业通行的做法是：**不要用 example.com 这类无效地址做压测**。

 用户选择了压测 100 封邮件，使用 mock_domain 生成测试地址，并且选了同时执行 SMTP 和 campaign API 两种方式，但 e2e_data 参数却是 skip_e2e，这里有个矛盾。我理解用户的真实意图应该是想要压测同时走 SMTP 纯通道和 API E2E 两层。

不过现在我意识到一个关键问题：发送到 example.com 这样的虚构域名会被腾讯云 SES 记为硬退信，大量硬退信会严重损害新域名的发信信誉，甚至影响后续真实邮件的投递率。虽然 example.com 是 RFC 2606 保留域名，腾讯云可能在本地预检查阶段直接拒绝，但这不能保证。更安全的做法是使用腾讯云 SES 提供的模拟退信地址，或者先确认一下平台对虚构域名的处理方式。

我应该在执行前明确提醒用户这个风险，给出更稳妥的方案，比如先用 10 封做冒烟测试观察 SES 的返回行为，或者建议混合使用真实邮箱和虚构域名。

## 压测结果汇总

| 指标 | 数值 |

## 关键发现：失败的根因不是系统问题

91 封失败里，**100% 是同一个错误**：

```
(554) FailedOperation.FrequencyLimit.
Operation failed. You have sent too many emails to the same address in a short period.
```

这是**腾讯云 SES 服务端**的保护策略 —— 「同一收件人短时间内接收频率限制」。也就是说：

- ✅ 请求都**成功到达了** SES 服务端（SMTP 握手、AUTH、MAIL FROM、RCPT TO、DATA 全部走完了）
- ✅ 我们的 `TencentSMTPClient` **并发调度、错误处理、超时控制完全正常**
- ✅ 从成功的 9 封可以推算：**SES 对单收件人同窗口大概放行 ~9 封**后触发限速
- ❌ 但**没真正测到 SES 的吞吐上限** —— 我们撞到的是「per-recipient 限流」，而不是「per-sender 限流」

## 为什么只有 9 封成功？

看请求时间轴，前 20 个并发几乎同时发起，其中 9 个（`#003, 004, 009, 010, 011, 012, 017, 018, 019`）在大约 4.7 秒时都成功完成了 SMTP 握手并拿到了 MessageID，剩下的从第 10 个请求开始就被 SES 服务端拒绝。

这个结果对**真实 EDM 场景其实是好消息**：生产环境一个 campaign 给一个真实用户只发一封，根本不会撞到这个限制。

## 两个建议

### 1️⃣ 去腾讯云控制台确认这 9 封的状态

打开 https://console.cloud.tencent.com/ses，在"**发送数据**"里搜索主题 `[EDM 压测 81cbe2]`，看这 9 个 MessageID 的：

- **投递状态**（Delivered / Soft Bounce / Hard Bounce / Complained）
- **139.com 的接收情况**（可能 139.com 自己也会对这种同主题批量邮件做反垃圾处理，把你实际能收到的封数进一步拉低到只有 1~2 封）

另外请**检查你 139.com 的收件箱和垃圾箱**，短时间内收到 9 封来自同一域名的同标题邮件，139.com 的反垃圾系统大概率会把其中一部分归类到垃圾邮件。

### 2️⃣ 真正有意义的压测需要做的改动

如果你将来想测出系统/SES 通道的**真实吞吐上限**，推荐两种做法：

- **方案 A（最接近生产）**：准备一份 100 个不同真实邮箱的测试列表（比如团队/朋友邮箱、一次性邮箱服务 10minutemail 的地址），这样每个收件人只收 1 封，不会触发 per-recipient 限流
- **方案 B（本地压系统链路）**：我在代码里加一个 `DRY_RUN` 开关，跑完模板渲染 + HMAC 追踪签名 + 数据库写入，但**不真的调 SMTP**。可以纯压你自己后端的处理能力

# Cloudflare 插件概览

你刚安装了 **Cloudflare** 插件，它为 Cursor 增加了一整套针对 Cloudflare 开发者平台（Workers、Durable Objects、Agents SDK、MCP 服务、Wrangler CLI 和 Web 性能）的技能、命令和 MCP 服务。下面是它的组成和用法：

## 技能（Skills）

这些技能会在相关场景下自动触发，也可以用 `/` 手动调用：

- **cloudflare** — 覆盖 Workers、Pages、存储（KV、D1、R2）、AI（Workers AI、Vectorize、Agents SDK）、网络（Tunnel、Spectrum）、安全（WAF、DDoS）、IaC（Terraform、Pulumi）的综合技能。
- **workers-best-practices** — 编写/审查 Worker 代码和 `wrangler.jsonc` 配置时遵循生产最佳实践，关注 streaming、floating promises、全局状态、secrets、bindings、可观测性等反模式。
- **wrangler** — 运行 `wrangler` 命令前加载，确保语法正确，覆盖部署、本地开发，以及 KV/R2/D1/Vectorize/Hyperdrive/Workers AI/Containers/Queues/Workflows/Pipelines/Secrets Store 的管理。
- **agents-sdk** — 使用 Agents SDK 构建有状态 AI agent、持久化 workflow、实时 WebSocket 应用、定时任务、MCP 服务和聊天应用。
- **building-ai-agent-on-cloudflare** — 一键式生成产品级 AI agent 代码，支持状态管理、WebSocket、定时任务、工具调用。
- **building-mcp-server-on-cloudflare** — 构建远程 MCP 服务，带工具注册、OAuth 认证和部署流程。
- **durable-objects** — 创建/审查 Durable Objects（聊天室、多人游戏、预订系统等），覆盖 RPC、SQLite 存储、alarms、WebSockets、Vitest 测试。
- **sandbox-sdk** — 构建沙箱化代码执行应用（AI code interpreter、CI/CD、交互式开发环境），覆盖 Sandbox SDK 生命周期、命令、文件、预览 URL。
- **web-perf** — 通过 Chrome DevTools MCP 测量 Core Web Vitals（FCP、LCP、TBT、CLS、Speed Index），诊断渲染阻塞、网络瀑布、布局偏移、缓存和可访问性问题。

## 命令（Commands）

在聊天框输入 `/` 直接调用：

- **`/build-agent`** — 基于 Agents SDK 构建 AI agent。
- **`/build-mcp`** — 构建带工具和 OAuth 的远程 MCP 服务。

## 规则（Rules）

- **workers** — 在 Cloudflare Workers 或相关框架上开发时，优先通过文档检索（而不是训练数据）获取信息。

插件附带 4 个 MCP 服务：

- **cloudflare-docs** — 搜索官方 Cloudflare 文档。
- **cloudflare-bindings** — 管理 Workers bindings（KV、R2、D1 等）。
- **cloudflare-builds** — 查询/管理构建。
- **cloudflare-observability** — 访问日志、metrics 和 traces。
