按 `bulkId` 查 `SendLog`（`select(SendLog).where(SendLog.ses_message_id == bulk_id)`），拿到 `recipient_id` / `campaign_id`\n  - 调用 `tracking_service.record_event(...)` 写事件\n  - 按事件类型 `update(SendLog).values(status=...)` 与 `update(Recipient).values(ses_status=...)`\n- `async def process_payload(db, body: dict | list) -> dict` 入口，支持腾讯文档里的单条 / 数组两种 body 格式，返回 `{received, processed, skipped}`\n\n### 2.3 新增 webhook 路由\n\n新文件 `edm-backend/app/api/webhooks.py`：\n\n``​`python\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/api/webhooks\", tags=[\"webhooks\"])\n\n@router.post(\"/tencent-ses\")\nasync def tencent_ses_webhook(request: Request, bg: BackgroundTasks):\n    # 1. 鉴权：校验 query 参数 ?token= 或 X-Tencent-Signature header 与 settings.TENCENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET\n    # 2. 解析 JSON（body 可能是 list[dict] 或 dict）\n    # 3. 记录原始 payload 到日志（DEBUG 级）\n    # 4. bg.add_task 调 webhook_service.process_payload\n    # 5. 立即返回 200 {\"code\": 0} 给腾讯云\n``​`\n\n说明：腾讯云 SES 回调本身没有官方签名机制，最常用做法是**在 URL 上挂一个足够长的 secret token**（如 `https://xxx.trycloudflare.com/api/webhooks/tencent-ses?token=<TENCENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET>`），服务端做常量时间比对。该 token 会写进腾讯云控制台的\"回调地址\"字段，只要不泄露就足够安全。\n\n### 2.4 注册路由\n\n在 [`app/main.py`](edm-backend/app/main.py) 第 45–56 行导入区加：\n\n``​`python\nfrom app.api.webhooks import router as webhooks_router\napp.include_router(webhooks_router)\n``​`\n\n### 2.5 小范围扩展 send_logs 状态枚举\n\n`SendLog.status` 当前取值：`pending` / `sent` / `failed`。新增允许值：`delivered` / `bounced` / `dropped`。模型字段是 `String(20)`，无需改表结构。只在 `webhook_service` 里更新即可。\n\n---\n\n## 3. Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 搭建\n\n无需 Cloudflare 账号、无需域名、无需 `wrangler`，只要下载一次 `cloudflared` 二进制。\n\n### 3.1 安装 cloudflared（Windows）\n\n用 PowerShell（或去 [cloudflared releases](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest) 下载安装包）：\n\n``​`powershell\nwinget install --id Cloudflare.cloudflared\n``​`\n\n### 3.2 启动 FastAPI + 隧道（两条终端并行）\n\nTerminal A — 后端：\n\n``​`powershell\ncd d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-backend\nuvicorn app.main:app --host ***REDACTED-IP*** --port 8000 --reload\n``​`\n\nTerminal B — 隧道：\n\n``​`powershell\ncloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:8000\n``​`\n\n输出类似 `https://random-words-1234.trycloudflare.com`。这是对外可访问的公网地址，指向本机 8000。\n\n### 3.3 测试\n\n``​`powershell\n# 健康检查\ncurl https://<subdomain>.trycloudflare.com/health\n\n# 模拟一条腾讯云回调\ncurl -X POST \"https://<subdomain>.trycloudflare.com/api/webhooks/tencent-ses?token=<TENCENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET>\" ^\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" ^\n  -d \"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"delivered\\\",\\\"email\\\":\\\"demo@x.com\\\",\\\"bulkId\\\":\\\"test-id\\\",\\\"timestamp\\\":1700000000}\"\n``​`\n\n---\n\n## 4. 腾讯云控制台配置\n\n按你截图所示路径：**邮件推送 → 回调地址 → 回调地址配置**\n\n- **账户级回调地址**（最稳妥，覆盖所有发信地址）：粘贴 `https://<subdomain>.trycloudflare.com/api/webhooks/tencent-ses?token=<TENCENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET>`\n- 也可在\"发送地址级回调地址\"新建一条仅对 `news@updates.tapnow.ai` 生效\n\n注意：快速隧道的子域名每次重启 `cloudflared` 都会变，回调地址要同步更新。长期使用建议升级到命名隧道（绑定自有域名）。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 验收清单\n\n- [ ] `POST /api/webhooks/tencent-ses?token=...` 在 token 错误时返回 401\n- [ ] token 正确时，无论 body 是单条 dict 还是 list[dict]，都能解析并立即返回 200\n- [ ] 真实发一封测试邮件后，对应事件（delivered/open/click）能出现在 `tracking_events` 表\n- [ ] `send_logs.ses_message_id == bulkId` 命中时，`status` 按事件正确更新\n- [ ] 未命中 bulkId 也不会抛异常，只记录日志\n- [ ] `tracking_events.event_type` 仍然 ≤ 20 字符（最长 \"spamreport\" 10 字符，OK）\n\n---\n\n## 6. 未纳入此次改动\n\n- 命名隧道 / 绑定自有域名（`cloudflared tunnel create` 流程）——等功能跑通后再升级\n- Cloudflare Workers 做回调中继（Workers 预处理再转发后端）\n- 对 `X-Tencentcloudses-Cb-Custom` 自定义头的进一步解析（目前只做兜底记录）",

 "contents": "\"\"\"Webhook endpoints for external email service callbacks.\n\nCurrently implements Tencent Cloud SES (邮件推送) event callbacks. The\nendpoint is protected by a shared secret passed as `?token=...` — the URL\n(with the token) is registered in the Tencent Cloud console under\n\"邮件推送 → 回调地址\".\n\nTencent Cloud always returns HTTP 200 to us; we always return 200 quickly\nand process events in the background so we never hold up delivery.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hmac\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks, HTTPException, Request, status\n\nfrom app.config import settings\nfrom app.database import async_session\nfrom app.services import webhook_service\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(\"webhook.api\")\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/api/webhooks\", tags=[\"webhooks\"])\n\n\ndef _validate_token(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Constant-time compare the ?token=... query param with the configured secret.\"\"\"\n    secret = settings.TENCENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET or \"\"\n    if not secret:\n        logger.error(\n            \"TENCENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty — rejecting all webhook calls. \"\n            \"Set it in .env before enabling the callback URL on Tencent Cloud.\"\n        )\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,\n            detail=\"Webhook not configured\",\n        )\n\n    token = request.query_params.get(\"token\") or request.headers.get(\n        \"X-Tencent-Webhook-Token\", \"\"\n    )\n    if not hmac.compare_digest(token, secret):\n        logger.warning(\"Webhook token mismatch | ip=%s\", request.client.host if request.client else \"?\")\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,\n            detail=\"Invalid webhook token\",\n        )\n\n\nasync def _process_payload_bg(payload: Any) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Run the actual DB work in a background task with its own session.\"\"\"\n    async with async_session() as db:\n        try:\n            await webhook_service.process_payload(db, payload)\n        except Exception:\n            logger.exception(\"Unhandled error while processing Tencent SES webhook\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/tencent-ses\")\nasync def tencent_ses_webhook(request: Request, bg: BackgroundTasks):\n    \"\"\"Receive Tencent Cloud SES event notifications.\n\n    Tencent may send either a single event object or a list of events\n    (batched). We accept both and always respond HTTP 200 as long as the\n    token is valid and the body parses as JSON — actual processing is\n    queued to a background task so we don't slow Tencent down.\n    \"\"\"\n    _validate_token(request)\n\n    raw = await request.body()\n    if not raw:\n        return {\"code\": 0, \"received\": 0, \"message\": \"empty body\"}\n\n    try:\n        payload: Any = json.loads(raw)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n        logger.warning(\"Invalid JSON in webhook body: %s\", exc)\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,\n            detail=\"Invalid JSON body\",\n        ) from exc\n\n    if isinstance(payload, dict):\n        received = 1\n    elif isinstance(payload, list):\n        received = len(payload)\n    else:\n        logger.warning(\"Webhook payload is neither object nor array: %r\", payload)\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,\n            detail=\"Payload must be a JSON object or array\",\n        )\n\n    if settings.DEBUG:\n        logger.debug(\"Tencent SES webhook payload: %s\", payload)\n    else:\n        logger.info(\"Tencent SES webhook received | events=%d\", received)\n\n    bg.add_task(_process_payload_bg, payload)\n\n    return {\"code\": 0, \"received\": received, \"message\": \"accepted\"}\n",

## 原因

腾讯云 SES 的 `open` / `click` 事件需要**事先在控制台开启"追踪域名"**：

- **`open`**：靠在邮件 HTML 里插入一个 1×1 追踪像素 `<img src="https://tracking-domain/...">`。如果没配追踪域名，就不会插入像素 → 永远收不到 `open`。
- **`click`**：靠把邮件里的链接改写成 `https://tracking-domain/redirect?...`。我们发的那封邮件里的 `<a href="https://tapnow.ai?...">` 是原始链接，**没被腾讯云改写**，你点击后直接打开原网页，腾讯云完全不知情。

另外，**QQ 邮箱默认阻止远程图片加载**，即使追踪像素插进去了，不手动点"显示图片"也不会触发 `open`。

## 怎么开启 open/click 追踪

在腾讯云控制台：

1. **邮件推送 → 追踪域名**（或"追踪设置"）
2. 添加一个你拥有的子域名作为追踪域名，比如 `track.tapnow.ai`
3. 按提示去域名 DNS 解析加一条 **CNAME 记录**（指向腾讯云给的目标）
4. 验证通过后，**回到回调地址同一级菜单或追踪域名菜单开启"打开追踪"和"点击追踪"**

之后再发邮件，腾讯云会在每封邮件里：
- 自动末尾插入追踪像素
- 自动把 `<a href>` 改写成经过 `track.tapnow.ai` 的跳转链接

然后 `open` / `click` 才能 POST 到你的 webhook。

## 现阶段结论

- **Cloudflare Tunnel → FastAPI webhook 链路 100% 打通了**
- **腾讯云 → 你 webhook 的投递路径正常**（`delivered`、`bounce` 都到了）
- 剩下 `open`/`click` 只差腾讯云控制台里加一个 **CNAME 追踪域名** + 开启开关
